---
title: "Peptide-to-isoform evidence mapping and genome-browser panels"
output: html_document
---

## Purpose

CAD sQTL junctions were assigned to full-length VSMC transcript and protein isoforms in the
preceding scripts, but the predicted proteome is derived from transcript sequence, so this script
asks which of those isoforms are supported at the protein level. Peptides detected by discovery
proteomics (DDA and real-time-search acquisitions) and by targeted IS-PRM are matched by
sequence to the Cleaver in-silico digest of the predicted proteome, which gives the complete set
of isoforms each peptide can evidence independently of where PoGo placed it on the genome.
Each peptide is then classified against the risk-associated and nonrisk-associated isoform sets
of a CAD cluster (and of each CAD junction) as Risk, Nonrisk, Both (shared) or Neither; only
Risk and Nonrisk peptides count as isoform validation because shared sequence cannot
distinguish the two products. The same script holds the genome-browser plotting machinery and
draws every browser panel in the manuscript, because those panels show the isoforms and
peptides chosen by the evidence tables built here.

## Manuscript outputs produced

- Numbers in Results: CAD sGenes with detected peptides (124 of 168), peptides at CAD sQTL
  junctions and the shared fraction (578 / 405), probeable junctions with isoform-unique peptide
  support (67 of 133); Methods: the 173 IS-PRM target peptides by specificity class.
- Supplementary Table 12 (peptide evidence in CAD sGenes) and the peptide-evidence columns of
  Supplementary Table 13 (junction master), assembled by `10_figure_and_table_generation.Rmd`.
- Source tables for Fig. 4g, Extended Data Fig. 4a and Extended Data Fig. 5c (plotted in script 10).
- Genome-browser panels: Fig. 1e, 2c, 2f, 3e, 3f, 4i, 6a, 6f, 6k; Extended Data Fig. 1b, 2d, 2f,
  2h, 3g, 3h, 4b, 4d, 6a, 6c, 6e, 6g.

## Inputs

- `OUT_LFC_INTEGRATED` (script 01): CAD sQTL junctions with effect direction relative to the
  CAD risk allele.
- `OUT_PAIRS_UNIFIED_FLAGGED`, `OUT_JUNCTION_ISOFORM_MAP`, `OUT_CAD_JUNCTION_CODING`
  (script 02): risk/nonrisk isoform pairs, junction-to-isoform map and junction coding class.
- `F_SMC_GTF`, `F_SMC_EXON_COORDS`, `F_SQANTI_PROTEIN_CPM`, `F_SQANTI_PROTEIN_TSV`: long-read
  transcript models, exon table and SQANTI Protein classification of the VSMC isoforms.
- `F_GENCODE_V38_GTF`, `F_GENCODE_V38_EXONS`: GENCODE v38 models drawn alongside the long-read
  isoforms.
- `D_UNIPROT_BED`: UCSC UniProt track exports (hg38) for the protein-feature tracks.
- `F_ISPRM_DETECTED`, `F_CAD173_TARGETS`, `F_POGO_*_BED`: IS-PRM detections, the IS-PRM target
  list and PoGo genomic coordinates of all detected peptides.
- `F_CLEAVER_DIGEST`: Cleaver tryptic digest of the hybrid VSMC/GENCODE proteome.
- `F_CAD_SQTL_SNPS_LD`, `F_COLOC_WITH_SLOPES`, `F_RT_PCR_PRIMERS`: SNPs and RT-PCR amplicons for
  the browser tracks.

## Outputs (all in `RES_05`)

- `peptide_isoform_evidence_detail.csv` — one row per evaluable peptide × cluster
  (script 10: Fig. 4g source, Extended Data Fig. 4a, 5c).
- `junction_validation_seqfirst.csv`, `exclusive_peptide_possibility_per_junction.csv`,
  `junction_not_usable_reasons.csv` — junction-level validation (script 10: junction master,
  Supplementary Table 13, Fig. 4g).
- `evidence_chain.csv` — the junction counts quoted in the text.
- `SuppTable_CAD_sGene_peptide_evidence.csv` — Supplementary Table 12.
- `validated_interesting_isoform_candidates_bonafide.csv` — peptide-supported isoforms with
  notable features (Extended Data Fig. 5c).
- `isprm_cad173_target_summary.csv` — the 173 IS-PRM targets by specificity class.
- `browser_panels/<panel>_<gene>.{png,svg}` (genomic view), `<panel>_<gene>_exonview.{png,svg}`
  and `BROWSER_MANIFEST.csv`.

## Run order

Scripts 01 and 02 must have run. Within this file, run Part A (setup and plotting machinery),
then Part B (peptide evidence), then Part C (browser panels); Part C reads `detail` from Part B.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 3.5, fig.height = 3.5, dpi = 300)
options(tibble.width = Inf, scipen = 999)
```

## 2. Transcript models

The long-read exon table carries one row per exon with `trans_id` of the form
`GENE|PB.x.y|CPM`; CDS segments come from the GTF because the browser panels draw the coding
portion of each transcript thicker than the UTRs.

```{r load_smc_data}
exon_data  <- read_tsv(F_SMC_EXON_COORDS, show_col_types = FALSE)
smc_gtf_df <- as.data.frame(rtracklayer::import(F_SMC_GTF))
cds_data   <- smc_gtf_df %>% filter(type == "CDS")
```

```{r load_cluster_data}
# CAD sQTL junctions (script 01): one row per junction x condition; effect_direction is
# relative to the CAD risk allele. The table serves both as the browser sQTL track
# (cluster_data) and as the junction universe for the peptide evidence (lfc).
cluster_data <- read_tsv(OUT_LFC_INTEGRATED, show_col_types = FALSE)
if ("effect_direction" %in% names(cluster_data) && !"Effect_direction" %in% names(cluster_data))
  cluster_data <- cluster_data %>% mutate(Effect_direction = effect_direction)
lfc <- cluster_data
# Every lead SNP must carry a single ref/alt assignment; two entries would make the
# effect direction ambiguous.
dup_snp <- lfc %>% distinct(SNP_ID, ref, alt) %>% count(SNP_ID) %>% filter(n > 1)
stopifnot("a lead SNP carries two ref/alt entries in the integrated sQTL table" = nrow(dup_snp) == 0)
cat(sprintf("cluster_data: %d junction rows | %d distinct junctions | %d genes\n",
            nrow(cluster_data), n_distinct(cluster_data$junction_key),
            n_distinct(cluster_data$gene_name)))
```

```{r load_pairs}
# Risk/nonrisk isoform pairs (script 02). The plotting function branches on
# risk_isoform / nonrisk_isoform (ENST-level pairs), so those columns are added as NA
# and PB accessions are normalised to the bare PB.x.y form.
risk_pairs <- read_csv(OUT_PAIRS_UNIFIED_FLAGGED, show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot("expected risk_pb / nonrisk_pb" = all(c("risk_pb", "nonrisk_pb") %in% names(risk_pairs)))
risk_pairs <- risk_pairs %>%
  mutate(risk_pb    = coalesce(str_extract(risk_pb,    "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"), risk_pb),
         nonrisk_pb = coalesce(str_extract(nonrisk_pb, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"), nonrisk_pb),
         risk_isoform = NA_character_, nonrisk_isoform = NA_character_)
```

## 3. UniProt feature tracks

The UCSC UniProt track BEDs are bigBed exports whose column count differs between tracks, so
the full feature name and the UniProt accession are located by content rather than by position.
BED coordinates are 0-based half-open and are shifted to 1-based here to match the GTF-derived
transcript coordinates.

```{r load_uniprot}
read_uniprot_bed <- function(path) {
  raw <- read_tsv(path, col_names = FALSE, col_types = cols(.default = "c"),
                  show_col_types = FALSE)
  std <- c("chrom", "chromStart", "chromEnd", "name", "score", "strand",
           "thickStart", "thickEnd", "itemRgb", "blockCount", "blockSizes",
           "chromStarts", "status1", "status2", "level", "source",
           "review_status", "feature_type", "description", "feature_name", "uniprot_id")
  names(raw)[seq_len(min(length(std), ncol(raw)))] <- std[seq_len(min(length(std), ncol(raw)))]

  # Extra field with the full (untruncated) feature name; the `name` column may hold a
  # placeholder such as "repeat".
  full_name_col <- if (ncol(raw) >= 27) raw[[27]] else NA_character_

  # UniProt accession pattern, searched across all columns.
  acc_pat <- "^([OPQ][0-9][A-Z0-9]{3}[0-9]|[A-NR-Z][0-9]([A-Z][A-Z0-9]{2}[0-9]){1,2})(-[0-9]+)?$"
  acc <- apply(as.matrix(raw), 1, function(r) {
    hit <- grep(acc_pat, trimws(r), value = TRUE)
    if (length(hit)) hit[1] else NA_character_
  })

  raw %>%
    mutate(
      .full = na_if(trimws(full_name_col), ""),
      name  = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(.full), .full, name),
      .acc  = acc,
      uniprot_id = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(.acc), .acc,
                                  suppressWarnings(as.character(uniprot_id))),
      chromStart = as.numeric(chromStart) + 1,
      chromEnd   = as.numeric(chromEnd)   + 1) %>%
    select(-.full, -.acc)
}

unip_signal        <- read_uniprot_bed(file.path(D_UNIPROT_BED, "unipLocSignal.bed"))
unip_extracellular <- read_uniprot_bed(file.path(D_UNIPROT_BED, "unipLocExtra.bed"))
unip_transmembrane <- read_uniprot_bed(file.path(D_UNIPROT_BED, "unipLocTransMemb.bed"))
unip_cytoplasmic   <- read_uniprot_bed(file.path(D_UNIPROT_BED, "unipLocCytopl.bed"))
unip_domain        <- read_uniprot_bed(file.path(D_UNIPROT_BED, "unipDomain.bed"))
unip_interest      <- read_uniprot_bed(file.path(D_UNIPROT_BED, "unipInterest.bed"))
unip_structure     <- read_uniprot_bed(file.path(D_UNIPROT_BED, "unipStruct.bed"))
unip_disulfide     <- read_uniprot_bed(file.path(D_UNIPROT_BED, "unipDisulfBond.bed"))
unip_modif         <- read_uniprot_bed(file.path(D_UNIPROT_BED, "unipModif.bed"))
unip_repeat        <- read_uniprot_bed(file.path(D_UNIPROT_BED, "unipRepeat.bed"))
```

## 4. PoGo peptide coordinates

PoGo places detected peptides on the genome for the browser peptide tracks. The IS-PRM BED is
restricted to peptides present in the filtered Tomahto output because PoGo retains some
peptides that did not pass the post-acquisition filters. `pogo_data` is used only for
plotting; the peptide evidence in Part B is sequence-based and does not depend on PoGo
placement.

```{r read_pogo_bed}
read_pogo_bed <- function(bed_file, skip_header = TRUE) {
  col_names <- c("chrom", "chromStart", "chromEnd", "peptide_seq", "score", "strand",
                 "thickStart", "thickEnd", "itemRgb", "blockCount", "blockSizes", "blockStarts")
  read_tsv(bed_file, col_names = col_names, skip = if (skip_header) 1 else 0,
           col_types = cols(.default = "c"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      chromStart = as.numeric(chromStart) + 1,
      chromEnd   = as.numeric(chromEnd)   + 1,
      blockCount = as.numeric(blockCount),
      # PoGo colours peptides by specificity: red = isoform-specific, black = gene-specific,
      # grey = shared between genes.
      specificity = case_when(
        itemRgb == "204,0,0"                         ~ "Isoform-specific",
        itemRgb == "0,0,0"                           ~ "Gene-specific",
        itemRgb %in% c("128,128,128", "169,169,169") ~ "Not gene-specific",
        TRUE                                         ~ "Unknown"),
      source_file = basename(bed_file))
}
pogo_tom <- read_pogo_bed(F_POGO_ISPRM_BED)
pogo_edj <- read_pogo_bed(F_POGO_RTS_BED)
pogo_dda <- read_pogo_bed(F_POGO_DDA_CAD_BED)
pogo_lbz <- read_pogo_bed(F_POGO_DDA_ALL_BED)
```

```{r tom_pogo_filter}
tom_results <- read_csv(F_ISPRM_DETECTED, show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot("expected a 'Peptide' column in the IS-PRM output" = "Peptide" %in% names(tom_results))

# Strip search-engine modification notation so that sequences compare on bare residues.
bare_seq <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_remove_all("\\[[^\\]]*\\]") %>%
    str_remove_all("\\([^\\)]*\\)") %>%
    str_remove_all("[\\+\\-][0-9\\.]+") %>%
    str_remove_all("[^A-Z]") %>%
    toupper()
}
tom_peps  <- unique(bare_seq(tom_results$Peptide))
tom_peps  <- tom_peps[nchar(tom_peps) > 0]
pogo_peps <- unique(toupper(pogo_tom$peptide_seq))
shared    <- intersect(pogo_peps, tom_peps)

pogo_tom_filt <- pogo_tom %>% filter(toupper(peptide_seq) %in% shared)
pogo_data     <- bind_rows(pogo_tom_filt, pogo_edj, pogo_dda, pogo_lbz)
```

## 5. SNPs and RT-PCR amplicons

Lead sQTL variants are flagged from the colocalization table so that they are drawn bold;
all other variants in the LD-expanded table are drawn as plain lollipops.

```{r load_snps}
coloc_slopes <- read_csv(F_COLOC_WITH_SLOPES, show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot("expected an 'rsid' column in the colocalization table" = "rsid" %in% names(coloc_slopes))
lead_rsids <- unique(na.omit(coloc_slopes$rsid))

cad_snps_raw <- read_csv(F_CAD_SQTL_SNPS_LD, show_col_types = FALSE)
shared_col   <- "Shared sQTL & CAD SNP"

snp_data <- cad_snps_raw %>%
  transmute(
    rsid       = .data[[shared_col]],
    chr        = if_else(str_starts(as.character(chr), "chr"),
                         as.character(chr), paste0("chr", chr)),
    pos        = as.integer(pos_hg38),
    ref, alt,
    gene_name  = GENCODE_name,
    lead_rsid_for_this_snp = query_lead_snp_rsid,
    lead_source            = query_lead_SNP_source) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rsid), !is.na(pos)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(is_lead = rsid %in% lead_rsids)

# Lead variants absent from the LD table are appended from the colocalization table.
if (all(c("chr", "pos_hg38") %in% names(coloc_slopes))) {
  coloc_extra <- coloc_slopes %>%
    transmute(
      rsid = rsid,
      chr  = if_else(str_starts(as.character(chr), "chr"),
                     as.character(chr), paste0("chr", chr)),
      pos  = as.integer(pos_hg38),
      gene_name = if ("gene_name" %in% names(coloc_slopes)) gene_name else NA_character_,
      is_lead = TRUE) %>%
    filter(!is.na(rsid), !is.na(pos)) %>%
    anti_join(snp_data, by = c("rsid", "chr", "pos"))
  if (nrow(coloc_extra) > 0) snp_data <- bind_rows(snp_data, coloc_extra)
}
```

```{r load_primers}
# RT-PCR primer workbook (Supplementary Table 6): the sheet holding the primer design is
# located by name, and the gene and hg38 amplicon-coordinate columns by pattern.
primer_sheet <- grep("primer", excel_sheets(F_RT_PCR_PRIMERS), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
stopifnot("no primer-design sheet in the RT-PCR workbook" = !is.na(primer_sheet))
primer_raw <- read_excel(F_RT_PCR_PRIMERS, sheet = primer_sheet) %>% as_tibble()
names(primer_raw) <- names(primer_raw) %>% str_replace_all("\\s+", " ") %>% trimws()

gene_col  <- names(primer_raw)[str_detect(tolower(names(primer_raw)), "gene")][1]
coord_col <- names(primer_raw)[str_detect(tolower(names(primer_raw)),
                                          "genomic|coordinate|h38|hg38")][1]
stopifnot("no hg38 amplicon-coordinate column in the primer sheet" = !is.na(coord_col))

primer_data <- primer_raw %>%
  transmute(gene = .data[[gene_col]], coord = .data[[coord_col]]) %>%
  tidyr::fill(gene, .direction = "down") %>%
  filter(!is.na(coord), str_detect(coord, "^chr")) %>%
  mutate(
    amplicon_chr   = str_extract(coord, "^chr[0-9XYM]+"),
    amplicon_start = as.numeric(str_extract(coord, "(?<=:)[0-9]+")),
    amplicon_end   = as.numeric(str_extract(coord, "(?<=-)[0-9]+")),
    amplicon_label = "RT-PCR amplicon") %>%
  filter(!is.na(amplicon_start), !is.na(amplicon_end)) %>%
  select(gene, amplicon_chr, amplicon_start, amplicon_end, amplicon_label)
```

## 6. Helpers

```{r helpers_ids}
# Full exon_data trans_ids ("GENE|PB.x.y|CPM") for a gene's PB accessions. The accession is
# matched up to the following "|" so that PB.1.1 does not match PB.1.10.
get_transcript_ids_for_gene <- function(exon_data, gene_symbol, pb_ids) {
  all_tx <- exon_data %>% filter(gene_id == gene_symbol) %>%
    pull(trans_id) %>% unique()
  out <- character(0)
  for (pb in pb_ids) {
    hits <- all_tx[str_detect(all_tx, paste0(fixed(pb), "\\|"))]
    if (length(hits) == 0)
      hits <- all_tx[str_detect(all_tx, paste0(fixed(pb), "$"))]
    out <- c(out, hits)
  }
  unique(out)
}

# Status (Risk / Nonrisk / Both) for each drawn peptide. A peptide that is not itself in the
# status map inherits the status of a mapped peptide it contains (missed-cleavage forms), or
# "Unknown" when that is ambiguous. Used by draw_peptide_track().
resolve_status <- function(seq, smap) {
  smap <- setNames(as.character(smap), names(smap))
  vapply(seq, function(s) {
    if (s %in% names(smap)) return(unname(smap[s]))
    hits <- names(smap)[stringr::str_detect(s, stringr::fixed(names(smap)))]
    st <- unique(unname(smap[hits]))
    if (length(st) == 1) st else "Unknown"
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
```

## 7. Coordinate helpers and the exon-view transform

Minus-strand genes are drawn reversed so that transcription runs left to right. The exon-view
transform collapses introns to a fixed pad so that short exons and peptides remain visible in
genes with long introns; every track is passed through the same transform.

```{r helpers_coords}
flip_coordinates <- function(coord, region_min, region_max) {
  region_max + region_min - coord
}

intersect_features_with_exons <- function(features_df, cds_coords) {
  if (nrow(features_df) == 0 || nrow(cds_coords) == 0) return(data.frame())
  cds_segments <- cds_coords %>% distinct(start, end) %>% arrange(start)
  result_list <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(features_df))) {
    feat <- features_df[i, ]
    overlapping_cds <- cds_segments %>%
      filter(end >= feat$feature_start, start <= feat$feature_end)
    if (nrow(overlapping_cds) == 0) next
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(overlapping_cds))) {
      cds <- overlapping_cds[j, ]
      seg_start <- max(feat$feature_start, cds$start)
      seg_end   <- min(feat$feature_end,   cds$end)
      if (seg_start < seg_end) {
        new_feat <- feat
        new_feat$feature_start <- seg_start
        new_feat$feature_end   <- seg_end
        result_list[[length(result_list) + 1]] <- new_feat
      }
    }
  }
  if (length(result_list) == 0) return(data.frame())
  bind_rows(result_list)
}
```

```{r exon_view_transform}
build_exon_view_transform <- function(exon_coords, intron_pad_frac = 0.015) {
  exons <- exon_coords %>%
    distinct(start = blockstarts, end = blockends) %>%
    arrange(start) %>%
    mutate(grp = cumsum(start > lag(cummax(end), default = -Inf))) %>%
    group_by(grp) %>%
    summarise(start = min(start), end = max(end), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(start)

  total_exon_length <- sum(exons$end - exons$start)
  intron_pad <- total_exon_length * intron_pad_frac
  exons <- exons %>%
    mutate(
      genomic_length   = end - start,
      cum_genomic      = cumsum(genomic_length),
      n_introns_before = pmax(0, row_number() - 1),
      plot_start       = cum_genomic - genomic_length + n_introns_before * intron_pad,
      plot_end         = plot_start + genomic_length)

  transform_fn <- function(x) {
    out <- numeric(length(x))
    for (i in seq_along(x)) {
      xi <- x[i]
      if (is.na(xi)) { out[i] <- NA_real_; next }
      if (xi <= exons$start[1]) {
        out[i] <- exons$plot_start[1] - (exons$start[1] - xi); next
      }
      if (xi >= exons$end[nrow(exons)]) {
        out[i] <- exons$plot_end[nrow(exons)] + (xi - exons$end[nrow(exons)]); next
      }
      idx <- which(exons$start <= xi & xi <= exons$end)
      if (length(idx) > 0) {
        k <- idx[1]
        out[i] <- exons$plot_start[k] + (xi - exons$start[k]); next
      }
      k <- which(exons$start > xi)[1]
      prev_end   <- exons$end[k - 1]
      next_start <- exons$start[k]
      frac <- (xi - prev_end) / (next_start - prev_end)
      out[i] <- exons$plot_end[k - 1] + frac * intron_pad
    }
    out
  }
  list(transform = transform_fn, exons = exons, intron_pad = intron_pad)
}

apply_transform_cols <- function(df, fn, cols) {
  for (cc in cols) if (cc %in% names(df)) df[[cc]] <- fn(df[[cc]])
  df
}
```

## 8. Track drawing functions

Each function returns the rectangles, stems and labels for one track, positioned above or below
the transcript models; the main plotting function assembles them. sQTL junctions increased in
usage with the CAD risk allele are drawn red and decreased junctions blue; overlapping elements
are packed onto sub-tracks so that nothing is hidden.

```{r draw_sqtl_junctions}
draw_sqtl_junctions <- function(cluster_data, gene_name, track_y,
                                region_start, region_end,
                                strand = "+",
                                junction_height = 0.18,
                                cap_width_factor = 0.004,
                                bar_height = 0.06,
                                track_spacing = 0.45,
                                show_highlight = TRUE,
                                highlight_alpha = 0.2) {
  increased_color <- "#ef5350"
  decreased_color <- "#7FA8E0"
  effect_col <- if ("Effect_direction" %in% names(cluster_data))
                  "Effect_direction" else "effect_direction"

  sqtl_junctions <- cluster_data %>%
    filter(gene_name == !!gene_name, !is.na(intron_start), !is.na(intron_end)) %>%
    distinct(intron_start, intron_end, !!sym(effect_col), .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      effect_type = case_when(
        str_detect(.data[[effect_col]], regex("Increase", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Increased",
        str_detect(.data[[effect_col]], regex("Decrease", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Decreased",
        TRUE ~ "Other"),
      fill_color = case_when(
        effect_type == "Increased" ~ increased_color,
        effect_type == "Decreased" ~ decreased_color,
        TRUE ~ "gray50"))

  if (nrow(sqtl_junctions) == 0)
    return(list(has_junctions = FALSE, max_y = track_y))

  if (strand == "-") {
    sqtl_junctions <- sqtl_junctions %>%
      mutate(orig_start = intron_start, orig_end = intron_end,
             intron_start = flip_coordinates(orig_end,   region_start, region_end),
             intron_end   = flip_coordinates(orig_start, region_start, region_end)) %>%
      select(-orig_start, -orig_end)
  }

  sqtl_junctions <- sqtl_junctions %>%
    arrange(intron_start) %>%
    mutate(sub_track = {
      tracks <- numeric(n())
      if (n() > 0) {
        tracks[1] <- 0
        if (n() > 1) for (i in 2:n()) {
          overlaps <- which(intron_end[1:(i-1)] >= intron_start[i])
          if (length(overlaps) > 0) {
            used <- tracks[overlaps]; av <- 0
            while (av %in% used) av <- av + 1
            tracks[i] <- av
          } else tracks[i] <- 0
        }
      }
      tracks
    }) %>%
    mutate(junction_y = track_y + (sub_track * track_spacing),
           cap_width  = (region_end - region_start) * cap_width_factor)

  left_caps <- sqtl_junctions %>%
    transmute(xmin = intron_start, xmax = intron_start + (cap_width * 2),
              ymin = junction_y - junction_height, ymax = junction_y + junction_height,
              fill_color, effect_type)
  right_caps <- sqtl_junctions %>%
    transmute(xmin = intron_end - (cap_width * 2), xmax = intron_end,
              ymin = junction_y - junction_height, ymax = junction_y + junction_height,
              fill_color, effect_type)
  middle_bars <- sqtl_junctions %>%
    transmute(xmin = intron_start + (cap_width * 2), xmax = intron_end - (cap_width * 2),
              ymin = junction_y - bar_height, ymax = junction_y + bar_height,
              fill_color, effect_type)
  highlight_boxes <- sqtl_junctions %>%
    transmute(xmin = intron_start, xmax = intron_end,
              fill_color, effect_type, alpha = highlight_alpha)

  list(has_junctions = TRUE,
       max_y = max(sqtl_junctions$junction_y) + junction_height,
       left_caps = left_caps, right_caps = right_caps, middle_bars = middle_bars,
       highlight_boxes = if (show_highlight) highlight_boxes else NULL,
       junction_data = sqtl_junctions)
}
```

```{r draw_peptide_track}
draw_peptide_track <- function(pogo_data, gene_chr, region_start, region_end,
                               track_y, strand = "+",
                               selected_peptides = NULL,
                               exact_peptides     = FALSE,
                               peptide_status_map = NULL,
                               overlap_sqtl_coords = NULL,
                               cap_height = 0.18, cap_width_factor = 0.004,
                               bar_height = 0.06, track_spacing = 0.45,
                               should_flip = FALSE, exon_coords = NULL,
                               risk_color = "#D66B6B", non_risk_color = "#6494C5",
                               both_color = "#6B3074", unknown_color = "#808080") {

  peptides <- pogo_data %>%
    filter(chrom == gene_chr, chromEnd >= region_start, chromStart <= region_end)
  if (nrow(peptides) == 0) return(list(has_peptides = FALSE, max_y = track_y))
  if (!is.null(selected_peptides)) {
    keep <- if (isTRUE(exact_peptides)) {
      peptides$peptide_seq %in% selected_peptides
    } else {
      peptides$peptide_seq %in% selected_peptides |
        vapply(peptides$peptide_seq,
               function(s) any(stringr::str_detect(s, stringr::fixed(selected_peptides))),
               logical(1))
    }
    peptides <- peptides[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  peptides <- peptides %>% distinct(peptide_seq, chromStart, chromEnd, .keep_all = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(overlap_sqtl_coords)) {
    peptides <- peptides %>% rowwise() %>%
      filter(any(chromEnd >= overlap_sqtl_coords$intron_start &
                 chromStart <= overlap_sqtl_coords$intron_end)) %>% ungroup()
  }
  if (nrow(peptides) == 0) return(list(has_peptides = FALSE, max_y = track_y))

  if (!is.null(peptide_status_map)) {
    peptides <- peptides %>%
      mutate(
        peptide_risk_status = resolve_status(peptide_seq, peptide_status_map),
        risk_fill_color = case_when(
          peptide_risk_status == "Risk"     ~ risk_color,
          peptide_risk_status == "Nonrisk" ~ non_risk_color,
          peptide_risk_status == "Both"     ~ both_color,
          TRUE ~ unknown_color))
  } else if (!is.null(exon_coords) && "risk_status" %in% names(exon_coords)) {
    risk_exons    <- exon_coords %>% filter(risk_status == "Risk")
    nonrisk_exons <- exon_coords %>% filter(risk_status == "Nonrisk")
    peptides <- peptides %>% rowwise() %>%
      mutate(
        overlaps_risk    = if (nrow(risk_exons) > 0)
          any(chromEnd >= risk_exons$blockstarts & chromStart <= risk_exons$blockends) else FALSE,
        overlaps_nonrisk = if (nrow(nonrisk_exons) > 0)
          any(chromEnd >= nonrisk_exons$blockstarts & chromStart <= nonrisk_exons$blockends) else FALSE,
        peptide_risk_status = case_when(
          overlaps_risk & overlaps_nonrisk ~ "Both",
          overlaps_risk    ~ "Risk",
          overlaps_nonrisk ~ "Nonrisk",
          TRUE ~ "Unknown"),
        risk_fill_color = case_when(
          peptide_risk_status == "Risk"     ~ risk_color,
          peptide_risk_status == "Nonrisk" ~ non_risk_color,
          peptide_risk_status == "Both"     ~ both_color,
          TRUE ~ unknown_color)) %>% ungroup()
  } else {
    peptides <- peptides %>%
      mutate(peptide_risk_status = "Unknown", risk_fill_color = unknown_color)
  }

  cap_width <- (region_end - region_start) * cap_width_factor
  peptide_coords <- peptides %>%
    mutate(peptide_id = row_number(),
           pep_start = chromStart, pep_end = chromEnd) %>%
    select(peptide_id, peptide_seq, pep_start, pep_end,
           peptide_risk_status, risk_fill_color)

  # Exonic block segments from the BED (so junction-spanning peptides draw as
  # their pieces, not one bar across the intron)
  pep_blocks <- peptides %>%
    mutate(peptide_id = row_number()) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(.seg = list({
      bt <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_split(blockStarts, ",", simplify = TRUE)))
      bs <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_split(blockSizes,  ",", simplify = TRUE)))
      ok <- !is.na(bt) & !is.na(bs); bt <- bt[ok]; bs <- bs[ok]
      if (length(bt) == 0) { bt <- 0; bs <- chromEnd - chromStart }
      tibble(seg_start = chromStart + bt, seg_end = chromStart + bt + bs)
    })) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(peptide_id, .seg) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(.seg)

  if (should_flip) {
    peptide_coords <- peptide_coords %>%
      mutate(ps_new = flip_coordinates(pep_end,   region_start, region_end),
             pe_new = flip_coordinates(pep_start, region_start, region_end),
             pep_start = ps_new, pep_end = pe_new) %>%
      select(-ps_new, -pe_new)
    pep_blocks <- pep_blocks %>%
      mutate(s_new = flip_coordinates(seg_end,   region_start, region_end),
             e_new = flip_coordinates(seg_start, region_start, region_end),
             seg_start = s_new, seg_end = e_new) %>%
      select(-s_new, -e_new)
  }

  peptide_coords <- peptide_coords %>%
    arrange(pep_start) %>%
    mutate(sub_track = {
      tracks <- numeric(n())
      if (n() > 0) {
        tracks[1] <- 0
        if (n() > 1) for (i in 2:n()) {
          overlaps <- which(pep_end[1:(i-1)] >= pep_start[i])
          if (length(overlaps) > 0) {
            used <- tracks[overlaps]; av <- 0
            while (av %in% used) av <- av + 1
            tracks[i] <- av
          } else tracks[i] <- 0
        }
      }
      tracks
    }) %>%
    mutate(peptide_y = track_y + (sub_track * track_spacing))

  left_caps  <- peptide_coords[0, ] %>%
    transmute(xmin = numeric(), xmax = numeric(), ymin = numeric(), ymax = numeric(),
              fill_color = character(), peptide_risk_status = character())
  right_caps <- left_caps
  pep_introns <- pep_blocks %>%
    dplyr::group_by(peptide_id) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(xmin = min(seg_start), xmax = max(seg_end), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      peptide_coords %>% dplyr::select(peptide_id, peptide_y, risk_fill_color),
      by = "peptide_id") %>%
    transmute(xmin, xmax,
              ymin = peptide_y - bar_height, ymax = peptide_y + bar_height,
              fill_color = risk_fill_color)
  middle_bars <- pep_blocks %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      peptide_coords %>% dplyr::select(peptide_id, peptide_y,
                                       risk_fill_color, peptide_risk_status),
      by = "peptide_id") %>%
    transmute(xmin = seg_start, xmax = seg_end,
              ymin = peptide_y - cap_height, ymax = peptide_y + cap_height,
              fill_color = risk_fill_color, peptide_risk_status)
  peptide_labels <- peptide_coords %>%
    mutate(mid_x = (pep_start + pep_end) / 2, label = peptide_seq)

  list(has_peptides = TRUE,
       max_y = max(peptide_coords$peptide_y) + cap_height,
       left_caps = left_caps, right_caps = right_caps,
       middle_bars = middle_bars, pep_introns = pep_introns,
       peptide_labels = peptide_labels, peptide_data = peptide_coords)
}
```

```{r draw_snp_track}
draw_snp_track <- function(snp_data, gene_chr, region_start, region_end,
                           track_y,
                           gene_symbol = NULL,
                           snps_to_show = NULL,
                           should_flip = FALSE,
                           lead_color  = "#000000",
                           other_color = "#666666",
                           lollipop_height = 0.25) {

  if (is.null(snp_data) || nrow(snp_data) == 0)
    return(list(has_snps = FALSE, max_y = track_y))

  snps <- snp_data %>%
    filter(chr == gene_chr, pos >= region_start, pos <= region_end)
  if (!is.null(gene_symbol) && "gene_name" %in% names(snp_data)) {
    by_gene <- snps %>% filter(gene_name == gene_symbol)
    if (nrow(by_gene) > 0) snps <- by_gene
  }
  if (!is.null(snps_to_show))
    snps <- snps %>% filter(rsid %in% snps_to_show)
  snps <- snps %>% arrange(desc(is_lead)) %>% distinct(rsid, .keep_all = TRUE)
  if (nrow(snps) == 0) return(list(has_snps = FALSE, max_y = track_y))

  snps <- snps %>%
    mutate(
      x_pos      = pos,
      stem_color = if_else(is_lead, lead_color, other_color),
      stem_size  = if_else(is_lead, 0.7, 0.35),
      label_face = if_else(is_lead, "bold", "plain"),
      point_size = if_else(is_lead, 1.8, 1.0))

  if (should_flip)
    snps <- snps %>% mutate(x_pos = flip_coordinates(x_pos, region_start, region_end))

  stems <- snps %>%
    transmute(x = x_pos, y_lo = track_y, y_hi = track_y + lollipop_height,
              color = stem_color, size = stem_size)
  heads <- snps %>%
    transmute(x = x_pos, y = track_y + lollipop_height,
              color = stem_color, is_lead, rsid, label_face, point_size)

  list(has_snps = TRUE,
       max_y = track_y + lollipop_height + 0.15,
       stems = stems, heads = heads, snp_data = snps)
}
```

```{r draw_primer_track}
draw_primer_track <- function(primer_data, gene_chr, region_start, region_end,
                              track_y, gene_symbol = NULL, should_flip = FALSE,
                              primer_color = "#7F7F7F", cap_height = 0.16) {
  if (is.null(primer_data) || nrow(primer_data) == 0)
    return(list(has_primers = FALSE, max_y = track_y))

  pr <- primer_data %>%
    filter(amplicon_chr == gene_chr,
           amplicon_end >= region_start, amplicon_start <= region_end)
  if (!is.null(gene_symbol) && "gene" %in% names(primer_data)) {
    bg <- pr %>% filter(gene == gene_symbol)
    if (nrow(bg) > 0) pr <- bg
  }
  if (nrow(pr) == 0) return(list(has_primers = FALSE, max_y = track_y))

  pr <- pr %>% mutate(xstart = amplicon_start, xend = amplicon_end)
  if (should_flip)
    pr <- pr %>%
      mutate(xs = flip_coordinates(xend,   region_start, region_end),
             xe = flip_coordinates(xstart, region_start, region_end),
             xstart = xs, xend = xe) %>% select(-xs, -xe)

  amp <- pr %>%
    mutate(y = track_y, cap_height = cap_height,
           y_lo = y - cap_height, y_hi = y + cap_height,
           mid = (xstart + xend) / 2, lab_y = y + cap_height + 0.18,
           amplicon_label = if ("amplicon_label" %in% names(pr))
                              amplicon_label else "RT-PCR amplicon")
  list(has_primers = TRUE, max_y = track_y + cap_height, amplicon = amp)
}
```

## 9. Main plotting function

`plot_transcripts_peptides_sqtl_v2()` draws a set of long-read and/or GENCODE transcripts for
one gene with optional sQTL-junction, peptide, SNP, amplicon and UniProt-feature tracks, coloured
either by risk/nonrisk status or by transcript novelty. GENCODE transcripts can be drawn faded
(`shadow_gencode`) as a reference for the annotation that preceded long-read sequencing. The
legend is built as a separate panel and stacked under the plot with patchwork.

```{r plot_function}
# lighten a hex colour toward white; used for GENCODE shadow transcripts
  fade_hex <- function(hex, amount = 0.55) {
    m <- grDevices::col2rgb(hex) / 255
    grDevices::rgb(t(m + (1 - m) * amount))
  }

  plot_transcripts_peptides_sqtl_v2 <- function(
  exon_data, cds_data,
  cluster_data       = NULL,
  risk_nonrisk_pairs = NULL,
  pogo_data          = NULL,
  sqanti_data        = NULL,
  gencode_exon_data  = NULL,
  gencode_cds_data   = NULL,
  snp_data           = NULL,
  unip_signal = NULL, unip_extracellular = NULL, unip_transmembrane = NULL,
  unip_cytoplasmic = NULL, unip_domain = NULL, unip_interest = NULL,
  unip_structure = NULL, unip_disulfide = NULL, unip_modif = NULL,
  unip_repeat = NULL,
  transcript_ids        = NULL,
  gene_name_for_cluster = NULL,
  selected_peptides     = NULL,
  peptide_status_map = NULL,
  peptides_overlap_sqtl = TRUE,

  color_by = c("risk", "novelty"),

  manual_risk_pbs    = NULL,
  manual_nonrisk_pbs = NULL,
  exact_peptides = FALSE,

  show_peptides  = TRUE,
  show_snps      = TRUE,
  show_sqtl      = TRUE,
  show_highlight = TRUE,
  show_peptide_labels = TRUE,
  show_snp_labels     = TRUE,
  show_feature_labels = TRUE,
  shadow_gencode = FALSE,

  snps_to_show     = NULL,
  lead_color       = "#000000",
  other_snp_color  = "#666666",

  collapse_introns = FALSE,
  intron_pad_frac  = 0.015,

  risk_color = "#D66B6B", non_risk_color = "#6494C5",
  novel_color = "#E8700A", annotated_color = "#4a4a4a",
  gencode_color = "#4a4a4a", unknown_color = "gray60",
  signal_color = "#E74C3C", extracellular_color = "#3498DB",
  transmembrane_color = "#7B2D8E", cytoplasmic_color = "#F39C12",
  domain_color = "#7B2D8E", region_of_interest_color = "#7B2D8E",
  structure_color = "#95A5A6", disulfide_color = "#E67E22",
  modification_color = "#D35400", disordered_color = "#7B2D8E",
  repeat_color = "#7B2D8E",
  highlight_alpha = 0.2,

  thickness_scale = 1.5,
  sqtl_cap_pt     = 1.2,
  plot_width_in   = 3.5,
  track_spacing   = 1.6,
  feature_track_spacing = 0.55,

  base_pt = 7,

  dedup_feature_labels = TRUE,
  collapse_repeat_numbers = FALSE,
  primer_data   = NULL,
  show_primers  = TRUE,
  primer_color  = "#7F7F7F",
  primer_label  = TRUE,
  transcript_label_wrap = TRUE,

  show_risk_legend             = TRUE,
  transcript_label_legend      = FALSE,
  transcript_label_legend_text = c("Novel: gene|PacBio ID|CPM", "Annotated: ENST ID|CPM"),

  show_tracks   = c("topology","domains","structure","modifications"),
  show_features = c("signal","extracellular","transmembrane","cytoplasmic",
                    "domain","interest","structure","disulfide","modification", "repeat"),

  transcript_label_position = c("left","right"),
  flip_negative_strand = TRUE,
  title = NULL,

  legend_heights = c(1, 0.22)   # patchwork ratio: plot panel vs legend strip
  ){
  color_by                  <- match.arg(color_by)
  transcript_label_position <- match.arg(transcript_label_position)

  pt2gg     <- function(pt) pt / ggplot2::.pt
  text_size <- pt2gg(base_pt)

  feature_colors <- c(
    "Signal peptide" = signal_color, "Extracellular" = extracellular_color,
    "Transmembrane" = transmembrane_color, "Cytoplasmic" = cytoplasmic_color,
    "Domain" = domain_color, "Region of interest" = region_of_interest_color,
    "Disordered" = disordered_color, "Structure" = structure_color,
    "Disulfide bond" = disulfide_color, "Modification" = modification_color, "Repeat" = repeat_color)

  # Resolve risk/non-risk
  rp <- risk_nonrisk_pairs
  if (is.null(rp)) {
    risk_isoforms <- nonrisk_isoforms <- risk_pbs <- nonrisk_pbs <- character(0)
  } else if ("risk_isoform" %in% names(rp)) {
    risk_isoforms    <- unique(na.omit(rp$risk_isoform))
    nonrisk_isoforms <- unique(na.omit(rp$nonrisk_isoform))
    risk_pbs    <- unique(na.omit(rp$risk_pb))
    nonrisk_pbs <- unique(na.omit(rp$nonrisk_pb))
  } else if ("role" %in% names(rp)) {
    risk_isoforms    <- rp %>% filter(role == "risk")     %>% pull(isoform) %>% unique()
    nonrisk_isoforms <- rp %>% filter(role == "nonrisk") %>% pull(isoform) %>% unique()
    risk_pbs    <- rp %>% filter(role == "risk")     %>% pull(pb_acc) %>% unique()
    nonrisk_pbs <- rp %>% filter(role == "nonrisk") %>% pull(pb_acc) %>% unique()
  } else {
    risk_isoforms <- nonrisk_isoforms <- character(0)
    risk_pbs    <- if ("risk"     %in% names(rp)) unique(na.omit(rp$risk))     else character(0)
    nonrisk_pbs <- if ("non_risk" %in% names(rp)) unique(na.omit(rp$non_risk)) else character(0)
  }
  if (!is.null(manual_risk_pbs))    risk_pbs    <- unique(c(risk_pbs,    manual_risk_pbs))
  if (!is.null(manual_nonrisk_pbs)) nonrisk_pbs <- unique(c(nonrisk_pbs, manual_nonrisk_pbs))

  # Subset SMC + GENCODE exon data
  if (!is.null(transcript_ids)) {
    enst_ids <- transcript_ids[str_detect(transcript_ids, "^ENST")]
    pb_ids   <- transcript_ids[!str_detect(transcript_ids, "^ENST")]
    exon_data <- exon_data %>% filter(trans_id %in% pb_ids)

    if (length(enst_ids) > 0 && !is.null(gencode_exon_data)) {
      gencode_subset <- gencode_exon_data %>% filter(trans_id %in% enst_ids)
      if (!"blocksizes" %in% names(gencode_subset) &&
          all(c("blockstarts","blockends") %in% names(gencode_subset))) {
        gencode_subset <- gencode_subset %>% mutate(blocksizes = blockends - blockstarts)
      }
      common_cols <- intersect(names(exon_data), names(gencode_subset))
      exon_data <- bind_rows(exon_data %>% select(all_of(common_cols)),
                             gencode_subset %>% select(all_of(common_cols)))
    }
  }
  if (nrow(exon_data) == 0) stop("No transcripts found.")

  gene_name_for_sqtl <- if (!is.null(gene_name_for_cluster))
                         gene_name_for_cluster else unique(exon_data$gene_id)[1]
  gene_strand <- unique(exon_data$strand)[1]
  gene_chr    <- unique(exon_data$chr)[1]
  should_flip <- flip_negative_strand && gene_strand == "-"

  # Per-transcript category
  transcript_order <- exon_data %>% distinct(trans_id, gene_id) %>%
    mutate(pb_id      = str_extract(trans_id, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"),
           is_gencode = str_detect(trans_id, "^ENST"),
           # GENCODE transcripts plotted alongside long-read isoforms are drawn
           # faded, as a visual reference for what was annotated before long-read
           # sequencing.
           is_shadow  = is_gencode & shadow_gencode)

  if (color_by == "risk") {
    transcript_order <- transcript_order %>%
      mutate(risk_status = case_when(
        trans_id %in% risk_isoforms    | pb_id %in% risk_pbs    ~ "Risk",
        trans_id %in% nonrisk_isoforms | pb_id %in% nonrisk_pbs ~ "Nonrisk",
        is_gencode ~ "GENCODE",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"))

    non_gencode <- transcript_order %>% filter(!is_gencode)
    if (nrow(non_gencode) > 0 && all(non_gencode$risk_status == "Unknown")) {
      warning(sprintf("color_by='risk' but no transcripts found in risk_nonrisk_pairs for '%s'. ",
                      gene_name_for_sqtl),
              "Pass manual_risk_pbs / manual_nonrisk_pbs to override.")
    }
    cat_colors   <- c("Risk" = risk_color, "Nonrisk" = non_risk_color,
                      "GENCODE" = gencode_color, "Unknown" = unknown_color)
    legend_title <- "CAD Risk Status"
    if (!any(transcript_order$risk_status %in% c("Risk", "Nonrisk")))
      legend_title <- NA_character_
  } else {
    if (is.null(sqanti_data))
      stop("sqanti_data is required when color_by = 'novelty'.")
    pb_col <- if ("pb" %in% names(sqanti_data)) "pb" else "pb_acc"
    tx_cat_lookup <- sqanti_data %>%
      select(all_of(pb_col), tx_cat) %>% distinct() %>%
      dplyr::rename(pb_id = !!pb_col)
    transcript_order <- transcript_order %>%
      left_join(tx_cat_lookup, by = "pb_id") %>%
      mutate(risk_status = case_when(
        is_gencode ~ "Annotated",
        tx_cat %in% c("novel_in_catalog","novel_not_in_catalog") ~ "Novel",
        tx_cat %in% c("full_splice_match","incomplete_splice_match") ~ "Annotated",
        TRUE ~ "Annotated"))
    cat_colors   <- c("Novel" = novel_color, "Annotated" = annotated_color,
                      "NA" = gencode_color, "Unknown" = unknown_color)
    legend_title <- "RNA Isoform Novelty"
  }

  if (!is.null(transcript_ids)) {
    transcript_order <- transcript_order %>%
      mutate(input_order = match(trans_id, transcript_ids)) %>%
      arrange(input_order) %>%
      mutate(y_position = row_number() * track_spacing) %>%
      select(-input_order)
  } else {
    transcript_order <- transcript_order %>%
      arrange(gene_id, trans_id) %>%
      mutate(y_position = row_number() * track_spacing)
  }
  exon_coords <- exon_data %>%
    left_join(transcript_order %>% select(trans_id, y_position, risk_status),
              by = "trans_id")

  cds_coords <- cds_data %>%
    filter(transcript_id %in% exon_coords$trans_id) %>%
    dplyr::rename(trans_id = transcript_id) %>%
    left_join(transcript_order %>% select(trans_id, y_position, risk_status),
              by = "trans_id")

  if (!is.null(gencode_cds_data)) {
    enst_in_plot <- exon_coords %>% filter(str_detect(trans_id, "^ENST")) %>%
      pull(trans_id) %>% unique()
    if (length(enst_in_plot) > 0) {
      gcds <- gencode_cds_data %>% filter(transcript_id %in% enst_in_plot)
      if (nrow(gcds) > 0) {
        gcds <- gcds %>% dplyr::rename(trans_id = transcript_id) %>%
          left_join(transcript_order %>% select(trans_id, y_position, risk_status),
                    by = "trans_id")
        cc <- intersect(names(cds_coords), names(gcds))
        cds_coords <- bind_rows(cds_coords %>% select(all_of(cc)),
                                gcds %>% select(all_of(cc)))
      }
    }
  }

  for_plotting <- exon_coords %>%
    group_by(trans_id, y_position, risk_status) %>%
    summarise(start = min(start, na.rm = TRUE),
              end   = max(end,   na.rm = TRUE),
              gene_id = dplyr::first(gene_id),
              strand  = dplyr::first(strand),
              chr     = dplyr::first(chr), .groups = "drop")

  sqtl_raw <- if (!is.null(cluster_data))
    cluster_data %>% filter(gene_name == gene_name_for_sqtl,
                            !is.na(intron_start), !is.na(intron_end))
    else tibble()

  all_starts <- c(for_plotting$start, exon_coords$blockstarts)
  all_ends   <- c(for_plotting$end,   exon_coords$blockends)
  if (nrow(sqtl_raw) > 0) {
    all_starts <- c(all_starts, sqtl_raw$intron_start)
    all_ends   <- c(all_ends,   sqtl_raw$intron_end)
  }
  region_start <- min(all_starts, na.rm = TRUE)
  region_end   <- max(all_ends,   na.rm = TRUE)

  if (should_flip) {
    exon_coords <- exon_coords %>%
      mutate(bs_new = flip_coordinates(blockends,   region_start, region_end),
             be_new = flip_coordinates(blockstarts, region_start, region_end),
             blockstarts = bs_new, blockends = be_new) %>% select(-bs_new, -be_new)
    cds_coords <- cds_coords %>%
      mutate(s_new = flip_coordinates(end,   region_start, region_end),
             e_new = flip_coordinates(start, region_start, region_end),
             start = s_new, end = e_new) %>% select(-s_new, -e_new)
    for_plotting <- for_plotting %>%
      mutate(s_new = flip_coordinates(end,   region_start, region_end),
             e_new = flip_coordinates(start, region_start, region_end),
             start = s_new, end = e_new) %>% select(-s_new, -e_new)
  }

  sqtl_base_y <- max(for_plotting$y_position) + track_spacing
  sqtl_result <- if (show_sqtl && nrow(sqtl_raw) > 0)
    draw_sqtl_junctions(cluster_data, gene_name_for_sqtl, sqtl_base_y,
                        region_start, region_end,
                        strand = if (should_flip) "-" else "+",
                        show_highlight = show_highlight,
                        highlight_alpha = highlight_alpha,
                        junction_height = 0.12 * thickness_scale,
                        cap_width_factor = 0,
                        bar_height = 0.04 * thickness_scale)
    else list(has_junctions = FALSE, max_y = sqtl_base_y)

  peptide_base_y <- if (sqtl_result$has_junctions) sqtl_result$max_y + track_spacing
                    else sqtl_base_y
  sqtl_coords_for_filter <- if (peptides_overlap_sqtl && nrow(sqtl_raw) > 0)
                              sqtl_raw else NULL
  peptide_result <- if (show_peptides && !is.null(pogo_data))
    draw_peptide_track(pogo_data, gene_chr, region_start, region_end,
                       peptide_base_y, strand = gene_strand,
                                              selected_peptides = selected_peptides,
                       exact_peptides = exact_peptides,
                       peptide_status_map = peptide_status_map,
                       overlap_sqtl_coords = sqtl_coords_for_filter,
                       should_flip = should_flip, exon_coords = exon_coords,
                       risk_color = risk_color, non_risk_color = non_risk_color,
                       cap_height = 0.12 * thickness_scale,
                       bar_height = 0.04 * thickness_scale)
    else list(has_peptides = FALSE, max_y = peptide_base_y)

  snp_base_y <- if (peptide_result$has_peptides) peptide_result$max_y + track_spacing * 0.15
                else peptide_base_y + track_spacing * 0.15
  snp_result <- if (show_snps && !is.null(snp_data))
    draw_snp_track(snp_data, gene_chr, region_start, region_end,
                   snp_base_y, gene_symbol = gene_name_for_sqtl,
                   snps_to_show = snps_to_show,
                   should_flip = should_flip,
                   lead_color = lead_color, other_color = other_snp_color,
                   lollipop_height = 0.25 * thickness_scale)
    else list(has_snps = FALSE, max_y = peptide_result$max_y)

  # Primer / amplicon track (sits just above the transcripts, below the SNP/peptide stack)
  primer_base_y <- max(for_plotting$y_position) + track_spacing * 0.5
  primer_result <- if (show_primers && !is.null(primer_data))
    draw_primer_track(primer_data, gene_chr, region_start, region_end,
                      primer_base_y, gene_symbol = gene_name_for_sqtl,
                      should_flip = should_flip, primer_color = primer_color)
    else list(has_primers = FALSE, max_y = primer_base_y)

  # UniProt features
  is_valid_df <- function(df) !is.null(df) && is.data.frame(df) && nrow(df) > 0
  prepare_uniprot_features <- function(unip_df, cat_str, g_chr, g_strand, r_start, r_end) {
    if (!is_valid_df(unip_df)) return(data.frame())
    filt <- unip_df %>%
      filter(chrom == g_chr, strand == g_strand,
             chromEnd >= r_start, chromStart <= r_end)
    if (nrow(filt) == 0) return(data.frame())
    out <- data.frame(
      chrom = filt$chrom, strand = filt$strand,
      feature_start = as.numeric(filt$chromStart),
      feature_end   = as.numeric(filt$chromEnd),
      feature_label = trimws(as.character(filt$name)),
      feature_category = rep(cat_str, nrow(filt))) %>%
      mutate(feature_category = ifelse(str_detect(tolower(feature_label), "disordered"),
                                       "Disordered", feature_category))
                                       if (isTRUE(collapse_repeat_numbers))
      out <- out %>%
        mutate(feature_label = str_remove(feature_label, "\\s+\\d+$") %>% trimws())
    if (should_flip) {
      out <- out %>%
        mutate(fs_new = flip_coordinates(feature_end,   r_start, r_end),
               fe_new = flip_coordinates(feature_start, r_start, r_end),
               feature_start = fs_new, feature_end = fe_new) %>%
        select(-fs_new, -fe_new)
    }
    out
  }

  raw_features_list <- list()
  if ("topology" %in% show_tracks) {
    tp <- list()
    if ("signal"        %in% show_features && is_valid_df(unip_signal))        tp$s <- prepare_uniprot_features(unip_signal,        "Signal peptide", gene_chr, gene_strand, region_start, region_end)
    if ("extracellular" %in% show_features && is_valid_df(unip_extracellular)) tp$e <- prepare_uniprot_features(unip_extracellular, "Extracellular",  gene_chr, gene_strand, region_start, region_end)
    if ("transmembrane" %in% show_features && is_valid_df(unip_transmembrane)) tp$t <- prepare_uniprot_features(unip_transmembrane, "Transmembrane",  gene_chr, gene_strand, region_start, region_end)
    if ("cytoplasmic"   %in% show_features && is_valid_df(unip_cytoplasmic))   tp$c <- prepare_uniprot_features(unip_cytoplasmic,   "Cytoplasmic",    gene_chr, gene_strand, region_start, region_end)
    if (length(tp) > 0) { td <- bind_rows(tp)
      if (nrow(td) > 0) { td$track_name <- "Topology"; raw_features_list$topology <- td } }
  }
  if ("domains" %in% show_tracks) {
    dp <- list()
    if ("domain"   %in% show_features && is_valid_df(unip_domain))   dp$d <- prepare_uniprot_features(unip_domain,   "Domain",             gene_chr, gene_strand, region_start, region_end)
    if ("interest" %in% show_features && is_valid_df(unip_interest)) dp$i <- prepare_uniprot_features(unip_interest, "Region of interest", gene_chr, gene_strand, region_start, region_end)
    if ("repeat" %in% show_features && is_valid_df(unip_repeat))
      dp$r <- prepare_uniprot_features(unip_repeat, "Repeat",
                                       gene_chr, gene_strand, region_start, region_end)
    if (length(dp) > 0) { dd <- bind_rows(dp)
      if (nrow(dd) > 0) { dd$track_name <- "Domains & Regions"; raw_features_list$domains <- dd } }
  }
  if ("structure" %in% show_tracks && "structure" %in% show_features && is_valid_df(unip_structure)) {
    sd <- prepare_uniprot_features(unip_structure, "Structure", gene_chr, gene_strand, region_start, region_end)
    if (nrow(sd) > 0) { sd$track_name <- "Protein Structure"; raw_features_list$structure <- sd }
  }
  if ("modifications" %in% show_tracks) {
    mp <- list()
    if ("disulfide"    %in% show_features && is_valid_df(unip_disulfide)) mp$d <- prepare_uniprot_features(unip_disulfide, "Disulfide bond", gene_chr, gene_strand, region_start, region_end)
    if ("modification" %in% show_features && is_valid_df(unip_modif))     mp$m <- prepare_uniprot_features(unip_modif,     "Modification",   gene_chr, gene_strand, region_start, region_end)
    if (length(mp) > 0) { md <- bind_rows(mp)
      if (nrow(md) > 0) { md$track_name <- "Modifications"; raw_features_list$modifications <- md } }
  }

  all_features_df <- NULL; feature_labels_df <- NULL
  if (length(raw_features_list) > 0) {
    raw_features_df <- bind_rows(raw_features_list)
    if (nrow(raw_features_df) > 0) {
      all_features_df <- intersect_features_with_exons(raw_features_df, cds_coords)
      if (!is.null(all_features_df) && nrow(all_features_df) > 0) {
      cur_y <- min(for_plotting$y_position) - track_spacing
        ty_map <- data.frame(track_name = c("Topology","Domains & Regions",
                                            "Protein Structure","Modifications")) %>%
          filter(track_name %in% unique(all_features_df$track_name)) %>%
          mutate(track_y_base = cur_y - (row_number() - 1) * track_spacing)
          all_features_df <- all_features_df %>%
          left_join(ty_map, by = "track_name") %>%
          mutate(feature_category = factor(feature_category, levels = names(feature_colors)))

        pack_envelopes <- function(starts, ends) {
          n <- length(starts); tracks <- numeric(n)
          if (n > 0) {
            tracks[1] <- 0
            if (n > 1) for (i in 2:n) {
              overlaps <- which(ends[1:(i-1)] >= starts[i])
              if (length(overlaps) > 0) {
                used <- tracks[overlaps]; av <- 0
                while (av %in% used) av <- av + 1
                tracks[i] <- av
              } else tracks[i] <- 0
            }
          }
          tracks
        }

        if (isTRUE(dedup_feature_labels)) {
          # Collapse every same-named feature (e.g. repeated WD/FG-GAP repeats)
          # onto ONE row. Each unique name = one envelope [min..max]; non-overlapping
          # names share a row. All boxes still drawn; backbone line + single label
          # tie the disjoint instances together.
          label_env <- all_features_df %>%
            group_by(track_name, feature_label) %>%
            summarise(env_start = min(feature_start),
                      env_end   = max(feature_end), .groups = "drop") %>%
            group_by(track_name) %>% arrange(env_start, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
            mutate(sub_track = pack_envelopes(env_start, env_end)) %>%
            ungroup() %>% select(track_name, feature_label, sub_track)
          all_features_df <- all_features_df %>%
            left_join(label_env, by = c("track_name", "feature_label"))
        } else {
          all_features_df <- all_features_df %>%
            group_by(track_name) %>% arrange(feature_start) %>%
            mutate(sub_track = pack_envelopes(feature_start, feature_end)) %>%
            ungroup()
        }

        all_features_df <- all_features_df %>%
          mutate(feature_y     = track_y_base - (sub_track * feature_track_spacing),
                 feature_y_min = feature_y - 0.15 * thickness_scale,
                 feature_y_max = feature_y + 0.15 * thickness_scale)

        feature_labels_df <- all_features_df %>%
          group_by(track_name, feature_category, feature_label, feature_y) %>%
          mutate(segment_width = feature_end - feature_start) %>%
          slice_max(segment_width, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
          mutate(mid = (feature_start + feature_end) / 2) %>%
          select(track_name, feature_category, feature_label, mid, feature_y)
      }
    }
  }

  # Capture genomic boundaries before exon-view transform overwrites them
  genomic_left  <- min(exon_coords$blockstarts, na.rm = TRUE)
  genomic_right <- max(exon_coords$blockends,   na.rm = TRUE)

  if (collapse_introns) {
    ev <- build_exon_view_transform(exon_coords, intron_pad_frac = intron_pad_frac)
    fn <- ev$transform

    exon_coords  <- apply_transform_cols(exon_coords,  fn, c("blockstarts","blockends"))
    cds_coords   <- apply_transform_cols(cds_coords,   fn, c("start","end"))
    for_plotting <- apply_transform_cols(for_plotting, fn, c("start","end"))

    transform_track <- function(lst) {
      for (nm in c("left_caps","right_caps","middle_bars","pep_introns","highlight_boxes")) {
        if (!is.null(lst[[nm]])) {
          lst[[nm]]$xmin <- fn(lst[[nm]]$xmin)
          lst[[nm]]$xmax <- fn(lst[[nm]]$xmax)
        }
      }
      lst
    }
    if (isTRUE(sqtl_result$has_junctions)) sqtl_result <- transform_track(sqtl_result)
    if (isTRUE(peptide_result$has_peptides)) {
      peptide_result <- transform_track(peptide_result)
      peptide_result$peptide_labels$mid_x <- fn(peptide_result$peptide_labels$mid_x)
    }
    if (isTRUE(snp_result$has_snps)) {
      snp_result$stems$x <- fn(snp_result$stems$x)
      snp_result$heads$x <- fn(snp_result$heads$x)
    }
    if (isTRUE(primer_result$has_primers)) {
      primer_result$amplicon$xstart <- fn(primer_result$amplicon$xstart)
      primer_result$amplicon$xend   <- fn(primer_result$amplicon$xend)
      primer_result$amplicon$mid    <- fn(primer_result$amplicon$mid)
    }
    if (!is.null(all_features_df) && nrow(all_features_df) > 0) {
      all_features_df$feature_start <- fn(all_features_df$feature_start)
      all_features_df$feature_end   <- fn(all_features_df$feature_end)
      feature_labels_df$mid         <- fn(feature_labels_df$mid)
    }
    region_start <- min(exon_coords$blockstarts, na.rm = TRUE)
    region_end   <- max(exon_coords$blockends,   na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  raw_limits    <- c(region_start, region_end)
  span          <- diff(raw_limits)
  pad_right     <- span * 0.02
  pad_left      <- span * (if (transcript_label_position == "left") 0.42 else 0.05)
  padded_lim    <- c(raw_limits[1] - pad_left, raw_limits[2] + pad_right)

  # Recompute sQTL cap widths in DATA units from a physical pt target
  if (isTRUE(sqtl_result$has_junctions)) {
    pt_per_in   <- 72
    panel_data_span <- diff(padded_lim)
    cap_w_data  <- (sqtl_cap_pt / pt_per_in) / plot_width_in * panel_data_span
    mb <- sqtl_result$middle_bars
    sqtl_result$left_caps <- mb %>%
      mutate(xmax = xmin + cap_w_data,
             ymin = ymin - (0.12 * thickness_scale - 0.04 * thickness_scale),
             ymax = ymax + (0.12 * thickness_scale - 0.04 * thickness_scale))
    sqtl_result$right_caps <- mb %>%
      mutate(xmin = xmax - cap_w_data,
             ymin = ymin - (0.12 * thickness_scale - 0.04 * thickness_scale),
             ymax = ymax + (0.12 * thickness_scale - 0.04 * thickness_scale))
  }
  label_x_left  <- raw_limits[1] - span * 0.02
  label_x_right <- raw_limits[2] + span * 0.04

  # ========================== BUILD MAIN PLOT ==========================
  p1 <- ggplot()

  # sQTL highlight (background)
  if (isTRUE(sqtl_result$has_junctions) && !is.null(sqtl_result$highlight_boxes)) {
    y_min_hl <- if (!is.null(all_features_df) && nrow(all_features_df) > 0)
      min(all_features_df$feature_y_min) - 0.5 else min(for_plotting$y_position) - 1
    y_max_hl <- if (isTRUE(snp_result$has_snps))                snp_result$max_y + 0.5
                else if (isTRUE(peptide_result$has_peptides))   peptide_result$max_y + 0.5
                else                                            sqtl_result$max_y + 0.5
    hd <- sqtl_result$highlight_boxes %>% mutate(ymin = y_min_hl, ymax = y_max_hl)
    p1 <- p1 + geom_rect(data = hd,
                         aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
                         fill = hd$fill_color, alpha = hd$alpha, color = NA)
  }

  # Transcripts (thicker bars); fill is assigned per row rather than mapped as an aesthetic
  intron_h <- 0.04 * thickness_scale
  exon_h   <- 0.15 * thickness_scale
  cds_h    <- 0.30 * thickness_scale

  shadow_lookup <- transcript_order %>% select(trans_id, is_shadow)

  add_fill <- function(df) {
    df %>%
      left_join(shadow_lookup, by = "trans_id") %>%
      mutate(is_shadow = tidyr::replace_na(is_shadow, FALSE),
             .fill = ifelse(is_shadow,
                            fade_hex(unname(cat_colors[risk_status])),
                            unname(cat_colors[risk_status])))
  }

  exon_coords  <- add_fill(exon_coords)
  cds_coords   <- add_fill(cds_coords)
  for_plotting <- add_fill(for_plotting)

  p1 <- p1 +
    geom_rect(data = for_plotting,
              aes(xmin = start, xmax = end,
                  ymin = y_position - intron_h, ymax = y_position + intron_h,
                  fill = .fill), color = NA) +
                  geom_rect(data = exon_coords,
              aes(xmin = blockstarts, xmax = blockends,
                  ymin = y_position - exon_h, ymax = y_position + exon_h,
                  fill = .fill, color = .fill), linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_rect(data = cds_coords,
              aes(xmin = start, xmax = end,
                  ymin = y_position - cds_h, ymax = y_position + cds_h,
                  fill = .fill, color = .fill), linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    scale_color_identity()

  # sQTL track
  if (isTRUE(sqtl_result$has_junctions)) {
    p1 <- p1 +
      geom_rect(data = sqtl_result$middle_bars,
                aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
                fill = sqtl_result$middle_bars$fill_color, color = NA) +
      geom_rect(data = sqtl_result$left_caps,
                aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
                fill = sqtl_result$left_caps$fill_color, color = NA) +
      geom_rect(data = sqtl_result$right_caps,
                aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
                fill = sqtl_result$right_caps$fill_color, color = NA)
  }

  # Peptide track
  if (isTRUE(peptide_result$has_peptides)) {
    .pspan <- diff(padded_lim); .minw <- .pspan * 0.006
    .mb <- peptide_result$middle_bars
    .thin <- (.mb$xmax - .mb$xmin) < .minw
    .ctr <- (.mb$xmin + .mb$xmax) / 2
    .mb$xmin[.thin] <- .ctr[.thin] - .minw/2
    .mb$xmax[.thin] <- .ctr[.thin] + .minw/2
    peptide_result$middle_bars <- .mb
    p1 <- p1 +
      geom_rect(data = peptide_result$pep_introns,
                aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
                fill = peptide_result$pep_introns$fill_color, color = NA) +
      geom_rect(data = peptide_result$middle_bars,
                aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
                fill = peptide_result$middle_bars$fill_color, color = NA) +
      geom_rect(data = peptide_result$left_caps,
                aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
                fill = peptide_result$left_caps$fill_color, color = NA) +
      geom_rect(data = peptide_result$right_caps,
                aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
                fill = peptide_result$right_caps$fill_color, color = NA)
    if (show_peptide_labels) {
    p1 <- p1 + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        data = peptide_result$peptide_labels,
        aes(x = mid_x, y = peptide_y, label = label),
        size = text_size,
        min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.2,
        direction = "both", nudge_y = 0.6,
        box.padding = 0.4, point.padding = 0.2,
        force = 3, max.overlaps = Inf)
    }
}
    # track label for the peptide row, aligned with the transcript labels
  if (isTRUE(peptide_result$has_peptides)) {
    pep_lab <- tibble::tibble(
      y     = mean(c(peptide_base_y, peptide_result$max_y)),
      x     = if (transcript_label_position == "left") label_x_left else label_x_right,
      hjust = if (transcript_label_position == "left") 1 else 0,
      label = "Detected peptides")
    p1 <- p1 + geom_text(data = pep_lab,
                         aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, hjust = hjust),
                         size = text_size, lineheight = 0.9)
  }

  # SNP track
  if (isTRUE(snp_result$has_snps)) {
    snp_drop_y_bottom <- if (!is.null(all_features_df) && nrow(all_features_df) > 0)
      min(all_features_df$feature_y_min) - 0.2 else min(for_plotting$y_position) - 0.5

    p1 <- p1 +
      geom_segment(data = snp_result$heads,
                   aes(x = x, xend = x, y = y, yend = snp_drop_y_bottom),
                   color = snp_result$heads$color,
                   linewidth = 0.25, linetype = "dotted") +
      geom_segment(data = snp_result$stems,
                   aes(x = x, xend = x, y = y_lo, yend = y_hi),
                   color = snp_result$stems$color,
                   linewidth = snp_result$stems$size) +
      geom_point(data = snp_result$heads,
                 aes(x = x, y = y),
                 color = snp_result$heads$color,
                 size  = snp_result$heads$point_size)

                 if (show_snp_labels) {
      p1 <- p1 + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        data = snp_result$heads,
        aes(x = x, y = y, label = rsid, fontface = label_face),
        size = text_size, color = snp_result$heads$color,
        nudge_y = 0.5, segment.size = 0.2, segment.alpha = 0.5,
        direction = "both",
        force = 2, force_pull = 0.5,
        box.padding = 0.15, point.padding = 0.1,
        max.overlaps = Inf, show.legend = FALSE)
    }
  }

  # Primer / amplicon track
  if (isTRUE(primer_result$has_primers)) {
    amp <- primer_result$amplicon
    p1 <- p1 +
      geom_segment(data = amp, aes(x = xstart, xend = xend, y = y, yend = y),
                   color = primer_color, linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_segment(data = amp, aes(x = xstart, xend = xstart, y = y_lo, yend = y_hi),
                   color = primer_color, linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_segment(data = amp, aes(x = xend, xend = xend, y = y_lo, yend = y_hi),
                   color = primer_color, linewidth = 0.5)
    if (isTRUE(primer_label))
      p1 <- p1 + geom_text(data = amp,
                           aes(x = mid, y = lab_y, label = amplicon_label),
                           size = text_size, color = primer_color)
  }

  # UniProt features — hardcoded per-row fill
  if (!is.null(all_features_df) && nrow(all_features_df) > 0) {
    feature_spans <- all_features_df %>%
      group_by(track_name, feature_category, feature_label, feature_y) %>%
      summarise(span_start = min(feature_start), span_end = max(feature_end),
                .groups = "drop")
    all_features_df <- all_features_df %>%
      mutate(.fill = unname(feature_colors[as.character(feature_category)]))
    p1 <- p1 +
      geom_segment(data = feature_spans,
                   aes(x = span_start, xend = span_end, y = feature_y, yend = feature_y),
                   linewidth = 0.3, color = "gray40") +
      geom_rect(data = all_features_df,
                aes(xmin = feature_start, xmax = feature_end,
                    ymin = feature_y_min, ymax = feature_y_max,
                    fill = .fill), color = NA)
    if (show_feature_labels && nrow(feature_labels_df) > 0) {
    p1 <- p1 + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        data = feature_labels_df,
        aes(x = mid, y = feature_y, label = feature_label),
        size = text_size, min.segment.length = 0,
        segment.size = 0.2, segment.alpha = 0.3,
        direction = "both", nudge_y = -0.5,
        box.padding = 0.4, point.padding = 0.2,
        force = 3, force_pull = 0.5,
        max.overlaps = Inf, xlim = c(NA, raw_limits[2]))
    }
  }

  # Transcript labels
  # Display label: ENST accession for full-splice-match isoforms, PB accession otherwise.
  # The trailing |N of the PB trans_id is retained either way.
  tx_label_lookup <- if (!is.null(sqanti_data) &&
                         all(c("pb", "tx_transcripts") %in% names(sqanti_data))) {
    # An ENST label is used only for full-splice matches: an ISM is a fragment of the
    # reference, not the same transcript, and two ISMs against one reference would
    # otherwise receive identical labels.
    sqanti_data %>%
      dplyr::distinct(pb, tx_transcripts, tx_cat) %>%
      dplyr::transmute(pb_id = pb,
                       display = dplyr::if_else(
                         tx_transcripts != "novel" & tx_cat == "full-splice_match",
                         tx_transcripts, NA_character_))
  } else tibble::tibble(pb_id = character(), display = character())

  tx_label_data <- for_plotting %>%
    distinct(trans_id, y_position, is_shadow) %>%
    mutate(pb_id   = str_extract(trans_id, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"),
           cpm_tag = str_extract(trans_id, "(?<=\\|)[0-9]+$")) %>%
    left_join(tx_label_lookup, by = "pb_id") %>%
    transmute(trans_id, y_position,
              label_raw = if_else(!is.na(display) & !is.na(cpm_tag),
                                  paste0(display, "|", cpm_tag),
                                  trans_id),
              label_wrapped = if (transcript_label_wrap)
                                str_replace(label_raw, "\\|", "\n")
                              else label_raw,
              colour = if_else(is_shadow, "grey65", "grey20"),
              x = if (transcript_label_position == "left") label_x_left else label_x_right,
              hjust = if (transcript_label_position == "left") 1 else 0)
  p1 <- p1 + geom_text(data = tx_label_data,
                       aes(x = x, y = y_position, label = label_wrapped,
                           hjust = hjust, colour = colour),
                       size = text_size, lineheight = 0.9)
                       # track label for the sQTL junction row, aligned with the transcript labels
  if (isTRUE(sqtl_result$has_junctions)) {
    sqtl_lab <- tibble::tibble(
      y     = mean(c(sqtl_base_y, sqtl_result$max_y)),
      x     = if (transcript_label_position == "left") label_x_left else label_x_right,
      hjust = if (transcript_label_position == "left") 1 else 0,
      label = "sQTL splice junction(s)")
    p1 <- p1 + geom_text(data = sqtl_lab,
                         aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, hjust = hjust),
                         size = text_size, lineheight = 0.9)
  }
  # Tight y-limits
  # More headroom for SNP labels when there are many (they may stack vertically)
  n_snps_visible <- if (isTRUE(snp_result$has_snps)) nrow(snp_result$heads) else 0
  snp_label_pad  <- if (n_snps_visible >= 4) 1.0
                    else if (n_snps_visible >= 2) 0.5
                    else 0.2
  y_top <- if (isTRUE(snp_result$has_snps)) snp_result$max_y + snp_label_pad
           else if (isTRUE(peptide_result$has_peptides)) peptide_result$max_y + 0.5
           else if (isTRUE(sqtl_result$has_junctions)) sqtl_result$max_y + 0.5
           else max(for_plotting$y_position) + 0.5

           y_bottom <- if (!is.null(all_features_df) && nrow(all_features_df) > 0) {
    min(all_features_df$feature_y_min) - 0.3
  } else {
    min(for_plotting$y_position) - 0.6
  }
  if (isTRUE(primer_result$has_primers))
    y_bottom <- min(y_bottom, primer_result$amplicon$y[1] - 0.4)

    # Title
  strand_str <- if (gene_strand == "-") "− strand" else "+ strand"
  flip_str   <- if (should_flip)        ", reversed" else ""
  view_str   <- if (collapse_introns)   ", exon view" else ""

  # Position range (always shown - useful in both genomic and exon view)
  pos_lo_str <- format(genomic_left,  big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
  pos_hi_str <- format(genomic_right, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
  pos_str    <- sprintf("%s:%s–%s", gene_chr, pos_lo_str, pos_hi_str)

  meta_str <- sprintf("%s, %s%s%s", pos_str, strand_str, flip_str, view_str)
  plot_title <- if (!is.null(title))
    sprintf("*%s*<br>%s", title, meta_str)
    else sprintf("*%s*<br>%s", gene_name_for_sqtl, meta_str)

  x_label <- if (collapse_introns) NULL else "Genomic position (bp)"

  p1 <- p1 +
  scale_x_continuous(
      expand = expansion(0, 0),
      labels = if (should_flip)
        function(v) format(round(genomic_left + genomic_right - v), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
        else function(v) format(round(v), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off",
                    xlim = padded_lim,
                    ylim = c(y_bottom, y_top)) +
    theme_bw(base_size = base_pt) +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = x_label, y = NULL) +
    theme(
      text             = element_text(size = base_pt),
      plot.title       = ggtext::element_markdown(size = base_pt, hjust = 0.5,
                                      lineheight = 0.95, margin = margin(b = 2)),
      axis.title       = element_text(size = base_pt),
      axis.text.x      = if (collapse_introns) element_blank() else element_text(size = base_pt),
      axis.ticks.x     = if (collapse_introns) element_blank() else element_line(),
      axis.text.y      = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y     = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position  = "none",
      plot.margin      = margin(2, 4, 2, 2, "pt"))

  # ========================== BUILD LEGEND PANEL ==========================
  present_cats   <- intersect(names(cat_colors), unique(transcript_order$risk_status))
  sqtl_effects   <- if (isTRUE(sqtl_result$has_junctions))
                     unique(sqtl_result$junction_data$effect_type) else character(0)
  feat_cats      <- if (!is.null(all_features_df) && nrow(all_features_df) > 0)
                     as.character(unique(all_features_df$feature_category)) else character(0)

                     legend_rows <- list()
  if (length(present_cats) > 0 && !is.na(legend_title) && isTRUE(show_risk_legend)) {
    legend_rows[[length(legend_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      group = legend_title,
      level = present_cats,
      color = unname(cat_colors[present_cats]))
  }
  if (length(sqtl_effects) > 0) {
    effect_colors <- c("Increased" = "#ef5350", "Decreased" = "#7ba9ff", "Other" = "gray50")
    legend_rows[[length(legend_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      group = "CAD sQTL junction usage",
      level = sqtl_effects,
      color = unname(effect_colors[sqtl_effects]))
  }
  if (length(feat_cats) > 0) {
    legend_rows[[length(legend_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      group = "UniProt Features",
      level = feat_cats,
      color = unname(feature_colors[feat_cats]))
  }

  if (isTRUE(transcript_label_legend)) {
    legend_rows[[length(legend_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      group = "Transcript labels",
      level = transcript_label_legend_text,
      color = NA_character_)                     # NA colour = text only, no swatch
  }

  if (length(legend_rows) > 0) {
    legend_df <- bind_rows(legend_rows)
    # Align columns across groups so Risk/Increased stack, Non-Risk/Decreased stack
    lvl_order <- c("Risk", "Increased", "Nonrisk", "Decreased", "Other")
    legend_df <- legend_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(.ord = match(level, lvl_order),
                    .ord = ifelse(is.na(.ord), 99L, .ord)) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(group, .ord) %>%
      dplyr::select(-.ord)
      group_order <- intersect(c(legend_title, "CAD sQTL junction usage",
                               "UniProt Features", "Transcript labels"),
                             unique(legend_df$group))
    legend_df <- legend_df %>%
      mutate(group = factor(group, levels = group_order)) %>%
      arrange(group) %>%
      group_by(group) %>%
      mutate(x = row_number()) %>%
      ungroup()

    # y: groups stacked top-to-bottom (top = first listed)
    n_groups <- length(group_order)
    legend_df <- legend_df %>%
      mutate(y = n_groups - as.integer(group) + 1)

    n_cols   <- max(legend_df$x)
    x_label_col <- -0.2
    x_swatch_start <- 0.5

    legend_df <- legend_df %>%
      mutate(has_swatch = !is.na(color),
             swatch_x = ifelse(has_swatch, x_swatch_start + (x - 1) * 1.2,
                                           x_swatch_start - 0.13 + (x - 1) * 2.6),
             text_x   = ifelse(has_swatch, swatch_x + 0.13, swatch_x))

    group_label_df <- legend_df %>% distinct(group, y) %>%
      mutate(x = x_label_col,
             # tighter row spacing: multiply y to compress
             y = y * 0.55)

    legend_df <- legend_df %>% mutate(y = y * 0.55)

    p_legend <- ggplot() +
      geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(legend_df, has_swatch),
                 aes(x = swatch_x, y = y),
                 fill = dplyr::filter(legend_df, has_swatch)$color, color = "black",
                 shape = 22, size = 2.0, stroke = 0.15) +
      geom_text(data = legend_df,
                aes(x = text_x, y = y, label = level),
                hjust = 0, size = text_size, color = "black") +
      geom_text(data = group_label_df,
                aes(x = x, y = y, label = group),
                hjust = 1, size = text_size) +
      coord_cartesian(clip = "off",
                      xlim = c(-2.0, max(legend_df$text_x) + 1.2),
                      ylim = c(0.2, max(legend_df$y) + 0.35)) +
      theme_void() +
      theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 4, 2, 4, "pt"))

    out <- (p1 / p_legend) + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = legend_heights)
  } else {
    out <- p1
  }

  out
}
```

# B. Peptide evidence

Peptide classification is sequence-first: detections are joined to the Cleaver in-silico
digest by sequence, and the junction-membership call (Risk / Nonrisk / Both (shared) / Neither)
is made against the risk and nonrisk isoform sets built in section 12. PoGo coordinates play no
part in the classification, so peptides that PoGo could not place on the genome are still
evaluated.

## 10. Detected peptides

IS-PRM sequences come from the Tomahto output; discovery sequences (RTS and DDA acquisitions)
from the sequence column of the PoGo exports. A peptide is recorded once per platform, so that
the detection method can be reported per peptide.

```{r detections}
tom_raw <- read_csv(F_ISPRM_DETECTED, show_col_types = FALSE)
.tom_seq <- intersect(c("Peptide", "peptide", "Sequence", "Annotated.Sequence"), names(tom_raw))[1]
stopifnot("no peptide sequence column in the IS-PRM output" = !is.na(.tom_seq))

det_isprm <- tom_raw %>%
  transmute(pep = bare_seq(.data[[.tom_seq]]), platform = "IS-PRM") %>%
  filter(nchar(pep) >= 6)

read_pogo <- function(bed_file, platform) {
  read_tsv(bed_file,
           col_names = c("chrom", "chromStart", "chromEnd", "peptide_seq", "score",
                         "strand", "thickStart", "thickEnd", "itemRgb", "blockCount",
                         "blockSizes", "blockStarts"),
           skip = 1, col_types = cols(.default = "c"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(pep = bare_seq(peptide_seq), platform = platform,
              chrom, strand,
              chromStart = as.numeric(chromStart) + 1,
              chromEnd   = as.numeric(chromEnd)   + 1,
              blockCount = as.numeric(blockCount),
              blockSizes, blockStarts, pogo_itemRgb = itemRgb)
}
pogo_all <- imap_dfr(POGO_BEDS, ~ read_pogo(.x, .y))

detections <- bind_rows(
  det_isprm,
  pogo_all %>% filter(platform != "IS-PRM") %>% transmute(pep, platform)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pep), nchar(pep) > 0) %>%
  distinct(pep, platform)

peptides <- detections %>%
  group_by(pep) %>%
  summarise(platforms     = paste(sort(unique(platform)), collapse = "+"),
            via_isprm     = any(platform == "IS-PRM"),
            via_discovery = any(platform != "IS-PRM"),
            .groups = "drop")

# IS-PRM sequence set, used for the detected_by column of the evidence table.
isprm_peptide_seqs <- unique(det_isprm$pep)

cat(sprintf("distinct detected peptides: %s (IS-PRM %s | discovery %s | both %s)\n",
            comma(nrow(peptides)), comma(sum(peptides$via_isprm)),
            comma(sum(peptides$via_discovery)),
            comma(sum(peptides$via_isprm & peptides$via_discovery))))
```

## 11. Cleaver digest

The in-silico tryptic digest of the hybrid VSMC/GENCODE proteome lists, for every peptide, the
isoforms whose predicted protein contains it. This is the protein-membership truth against
which detections are interpreted; column names are resolved by pattern because the digest
export uses dotted names.

```{r cleaver_lookup}
cleaver_raw <- read_csv(F_CLEAVER_DIGEST, show_col_types = FALSE)

.pick <- function(df, patterns, what) {
  for (p in patterns) {
    hit <- grep(p, names(df), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
    if (length(hit)) return(hit[1])
  }
```
