```{r cleaver_lookup}
  stop(sprintf("cleaver_lookup: no column for '%s'. Available: %s",
               what, paste(names(df), collapse = ", ")))
}
.c_gene  <- .pick(cleaver_raw, c("^gene\\.?name$", "^gene_name$", "^gene$"),     "gene_symbol")
.c_seq   <- .pick(cleaver_raw, c("^AAseq$", "pep.*seq", "^sequence$"),           "peptide_seq_aa")
.c_ids   <- .pick(cleaver_raw, c("^IDs$", "pb.?ids", "iso.*ids", "accession"),   "pb_ids_list")
.c_ntot  <- .pick(cleaver_raw, c("iso\\.?total", "n_isoforms_total", "^total$"), "n_isoforms_total")
.c_nwith <- .pick(cleaver_raw, c("^count$", "n_isoforms_with", "with.?seq"),     "n_isoforms_with_seq")
.c_cat   <- .pick(cleaver_raw, c("^category$", "cleaver.?cat", "iso.*specific"), "cleaver_category")
.c_gspec <- .pick(cleaver_raw, c("gene\\.?specificity", "gene_specificity"),     "gene_specificity")

cleaver_lookup <- cleaver_raw %>%
  transmute(
    gene_symbol         = .data[[.c_gene]],
    peptide_seq_aa      = toupper(.data[[.c_seq]]),
    cleaver_category    = .data[[.c_cat]],
    gene_specificity    = .data[[.c_gspec]],
    n_isoforms_with_seq = suppressWarnings(as.integer(.data[[.c_nwith]])),
    n_isoforms_total    = suppressWarnings(as.integer(.data[[.c_ntot]])),
    pb_ids_list         = str_extract_all(.data[[.c_ids]], "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"))
```

## 12. Junction-to-isoform map and the junction funnel

The junction map (script 02) shares the `junction_key` format of the sQTL table, so joins are
exact. `funnel` records, for each of the 355 distinct CAD junctions, whether it is carried by
at least one long-read isoform (`lr_captured`) and whether it lies within a predicted CDS
(`probeable`, coding class "CDS (at least partial)", which already implies long-read capture).
Only probeable junctions can in principle be distinguished by a peptide.

```{r junction_map}
jm   <- read_csv(OUT_JUNCTION_ISOFORM_MAP, show_col_types = FALSE)
jcol <- intersect(c("junction_key", "cad_sqtl_junction"), names(jm))[1]
pcol <- intersect(c("pb_id", "pb_acc", "pb", "isoform", "trans_id"), names(jm))[1]
stopifnot(!is.na(jcol), !is.na(pcol))
jmap <- jm %>%
  transmute(junction_key = .data[[jcol]],
            pb_acc = str_extract(as.character(.data[[pcol]]), "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pb_acc)) %>% distinct()
isoforms_with <- function(jk) jmap %>% filter(junction_key %in% jk) %>% pull(pb_acc) %>% unique()

# Gene x cluster: junctions whose usage increases with the risk allele (risk) or decreases
# (nonrisk).
gj <- lfc %>%
  transmute(gene = gene_name, cluster, junction_key, dir = effect_direction) %>%
  mutate(role = case_when(str_detect(dir, regex("increas", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "risk",
                          str_detect(dir, regex("decreas", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "nonrisk",
                          TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(role), !is.na(junction_key), !is.na(cluster)) %>%
  group_by(gene, cluster) %>%
  summarise(risk_juncs    = list(unique(junction_key[role == "risk"])),
            nonrisk_juncs = list(unique(junction_key[role == "nonrisk"])), .groups = "drop")

# Gene -> all long-read isoforms (for the complement rule in section 13).
sqp <- sqanti_protein_cpm
pbc <- intersect(c("pb", "pb_acc", "isoform"), names(sqp))[1]
gnc <- intersect(c("gene", "gene_name", "associated_gene"), names(sqp))[1]
gene_iso <- sqp %>%
  transmute(gene = .data[[gnc]],
            pb_acc = str_extract(as.character(.data[[pbc]]), "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pb_acc)) %>% distinct()
all_iso_of <- function(g) gene_iso %>% filter(gene == g) %>% pull(pb_acc) %>% unique()

cds_class <- read_csv(OUT_CAD_JUNCTION_CODING, show_col_types = FALSE)
funnel <- lfc %>% distinct(junction_key) %>%
  mutate(lr_captured = junction_key %in% jmap$junction_key,
         probeable   = junction_key %in%
           cds_class$junction_key[cds_class$coding_class == "CDS (at least partial)"],
         cds         = probeable)
probeable_keys <- funnel$junction_key[funnel$probeable]
cat(sprintf("funnel: %d distinct junctions | %d long-read captured | %d probeable (CDS)\n",
            nrow(funnel), sum(funnel$lr_captured), sum(funnel$probeable)))
```

## 13. Risk and nonrisk isoform sets per cluster

Three rules define the stringency of "validating". Complement rule: when only one of the two
competing junctions was captured in long-read data, the other side is the complement of that
junction's isoforms within the gene. Ambiguity removal: an isoform carrying both junctions
cannot discriminate and is dropped from both sets. Usability gate: a cluster is classified only
when both sets are non-empty after ambiguity removal; one-sided clusters are excluded rather
than classified by default.

```{r isoform_sets}
gs3 <- gj %>% rowwise() %>%
  mutate(R0 = list(isoforms_with(unlist(risk_juncs))),
         N0 = list(isoforms_with(unlist(nonrisk_juncs))),
         all_iso = list(all_iso_of(gene)),
         R = list(if (length(R0) == 0 && length(N0) > 0) setdiff(all_iso, N0) else R0),
         N = list(if (length(N0) == 0 && length(R0) > 0) setdiff(all_iso, R0) else N0),
         amb = list(intersect(R, N)),
         R = list(setdiff(R, amb)), N = list(setdiff(N, amb))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(nR0 = lengths(R0), nN0 = lengths(N0), nR = lengths(R), nN = lengths(N),
         rule = case_when(nR0 > 0 & nN0 > 0 ~ "both junctions captured",
                          nR0 > 0 | nN0 > 0 ~ "complement (one junction captured)",
                          TRUE              ~ "no junction captured"),
         usable = nR > 0 & nN > 0)
```

## 14. Peptide classification

Detections are joined to the digest by sequence, so the gene assignment comes from the digest.
A peptide whose isoforms fall only in the risk set is a Risk peptide, only in the nonrisk set a
Nonrisk peptide, in both sets Both (shared), and in neither set Neither. Peptides evaluated in
more than one cluster of a gene keep the most informative call.

```{r classify_peptides}
pep_iso <- cleaver_lookup %>%
  transmute(gene_symbol, pep = toupper(peptide_seq_aa), seq_pbs = pb_ids_list) %>%
  distinct(gene_symbol, pep, .keep_all = TRUE)

detected_pep <- pep_iso %>%
  select(gene_symbol, pep) %>%
  inner_join(peptides %>% select(pep), by = "pep") %>%
  distinct()

cov <- detected_pep %>% left_join(pep_iso, by = c("gene_symbol", "pep"))

pc <- cov %>% filter(!is.na(seq_pbs)) %>%
  inner_join(gs3 %>% filter(usable) %>% select(gene, cluster, R, N),
             by = c("gene_symbol" = "gene"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(hR = map2_lgl(seq_pbs, R, ~ any(.x %in% .y)),
         hN = map2_lgl(seq_pbs, N, ~ any(.x %in% .y)),
         cls = case_when(hR & !hN ~ "Risk", !hR & hN ~ "Nonrisk",
                         hR &  hN ~ "Both (shared)", TRUE ~ "Neither"))
PRIO <- c("Risk" = 1, "Nonrisk" = 1, "Both (shared)" = 2, "Neither" = 3)
pep_call <- pc %>% mutate(p = PRIO[cls]) %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol, pep) %>% slice_min(p, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(gene_symbol, pep, junction_class = cls, cluster)

pep_class <- detected_pep %>%
  left_join(pep_call, by = c("gene_symbol", "pep")) %>%
  left_join(gs3 %>% group_by(gene) %>% summarise(any_usable = any(usable), .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("gene_symbol" = "gene")) %>%
  mutate(junction_class = case_when(
           !is.na(junction_class) ~ junction_class,
           is.na(any_usable)      ~ "no sQTL junctions for gene",
           !any_usable            ~ "not evaluable (no junction captured)",
           TRUE                   ~ "not in digest"),
         junction_validating = junction_class %in% c("Risk", "Nonrisk"))

ev <- pep_class %>% filter(junction_class %in% c("Risk", "Nonrisk", "Both (shared)", "Neither"))
```

## 15. Evidence tables

`peptide_isoform_evidence_detail.csv` holds one row per evaluable peptide with the isoforms its
classification rests on; it is read by script 10 (Fig. 4g, Extended Data Fig. 4a and 5c) and by
Part C to choose the isoforms and peptides drawn in each browser panel. `detected_by` is IS-PRM
when the sequence is in the Tomahto output.

```{r evidence_tables}
isprm_set <- toupper(isprm_peptide_seqs)
EVAL_LV <- c("Risk", "Nonrisk", "Both (shared)", "Neither")

detail <- pep_class %>% filter(junction_class %in% EVAL_LV) %>%
  left_join(pep_iso, by = c("gene_symbol", "pep")) %>%
  left_join(gs3 %>% filter(usable) %>% select(gene_symbol = gene, cluster, R, N),
            by = c("gene_symbol", "cluster")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(target = list(switch(junction_class,
                              "Risk"          = intersect(seq_pbs, R),
                              "Nonrisk"       = intersect(seq_pbs, N),
                              "Both (shared)" = intersect(seq_pbs, union(R, N)),
                              seq_pbs)),
         isoforms_evidenced   = paste(sort(unlist(target)), collapse = "; "),
         n_isoforms_evidenced = length(unlist(target)),
         all_isoforms_with_peptide = paste(sort(seq_pbs), collapse = "; ")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(detected_by = ifelse(pep %in% isprm_set, "IS-PRM", "Discovery"),
         peptide_class = factor(junction_class, levels = EVAL_LV)) %>%
  select(gene_symbol, cluster, peptide = pep, peptide_class,
         isoforms_evidenced, n_isoforms_evidenced, all_isoforms_with_peptide, detected_by) %>%
  arrange(gene_symbol, peptide_class, desc(n_isoforms_evidenced))
write_csv(detail, OUT_PEPTIDE_EVIDENCE_DETAIL)

pep_list <- function(p, d) {
  if (!length(p)) return(NA_character_)
  paste(ifelse(d == "IS-PRM", paste0(p, "*"), p), collapse = "; ")
}

# Cluster-level summary (IS-PRM peptides marked with *), used for the Results counts below.
summary_tbl <- detail %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol, cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_risk    = sum(peptide_class == "Risk"),
    n_nonrisk = sum(peptide_class == "Nonrisk"),
    n_shared  = sum(peptide_class == "Both (shared)"),
    n_neither = sum(peptide_class == "Neither"),
    risk_peptides    = pep_list(peptide[peptide_class == "Risk"],
                                detected_by[peptide_class == "Risk"]),
    nonrisk_peptides = pep_list(peptide[peptide_class == "Nonrisk"],
                                detected_by[peptide_class == "Nonrisk"]),
    shared_peptides  = pep_list(peptide[peptide_class == "Both (shared)"],
                                detected_by[peptide_class == "Both (shared)"]),
    risk_isoforms_evidenced = paste(sort(unique(unlist(
      str_split(isoforms_evidenced[peptide_class == "Risk"], "; ")))), collapse = "; "),
    nonrisk_isoforms_evidenced = paste(sort(unique(unlist(
      str_split(isoforms_evidenced[peptide_class == "Nonrisk"], "; ")))), collapse = "; "),
    isprm_risk    = sum(peptide_class == "Risk"          & detected_by == "IS-PRM"),
    isprm_nonrisk = sum(peptide_class == "Nonrisk"       & detected_by == "IS-PRM"),
    isprm_shared  = sum(peptide_class == "Both (shared)" & detected_by == "IS-PRM"),
    any_isprm     = any(detected_by == "IS-PRM"),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(evidence_class = case_when(
           n_risk > 0 & n_nonrisk > 0 ~ "1. BOTH isoforms validated",
           n_risk > 0 | n_nonrisk > 0 ~ "2. one isoform validated",
           n_shared > 0               ~ "3. shared peptides only",
           TRUE                       ~ "4. neither-junction peptides only")) %>%
  arrange(evidence_class, desc(n_risk + n_nonrisk), desc(n_shared))
```

## 16. Results counts at the peptide and gene level

These are the peptide-level numbers quoted in Results: the number of CAD sGenes with at least
one detected peptide, the peptides recovered at CAD sQTL junctions and the fraction mapping to
sequence shared by the isoforms of a gene, and the validating rate by platform. IS-PRM peptides
were selected to be isoform-distinguishing, so their higher validating rate reflects the
targeting design.

```{r results_counts}
cat(sprintf("CAD sGenes with >= 1 detected peptide: %d of %d\n",
            n_distinct(pep_class$gene_symbol[pep_class$gene_symbol %in% lfc$gene_name]),
            n_distinct(lfc$gene_name)))

cat("\nPeptides by junction class:\n")
print(pep_class %>% count(junction_class) %>% mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)))
cat(sprintf("\nEvaluable peptides %d | validating (Risk or Nonrisk) %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            nrow(ev), sum(ev$junction_validating), 100 * mean(ev$junction_validating)))

plat <- ev %>%
  left_join(peptides %>% select(pep, via_isprm, via_discovery), by = "pep") %>%
  mutate(platform = case_when(via_isprm & via_discovery ~ "Both",
                              via_isprm                 ~ "IS-PRM only",
                              via_discovery             ~ "Discovery only",
                              TRUE                      ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(platform))
cat("\nEvaluable peptides by platform:\n")
print(plat %>% group_by(platform) %>%
        summarise(n_total = n(), n_validating = sum(junction_validating),
                  pct = round(100 * mean(junction_validating), 1), .groups = "drop"))
```

## 17. Junction-level classification

The same rule as sections 13–14 with the CAD junction, rather than the gene × cluster, as the
unit, because Fig. 4g and Supplementary Table 13 report per junction. The "other" side of a
junction is the set of isoforms carrying the competing junction of the same cluster; the gene
complement is used only when no competing junction was captured in long-read data
(`used_complement`, weaker evidence). Junctions with no peptide at all are kept as zeros so that
the denominator is the full set of usable junctions.

```{r junction_classification}
# One row per gene x cluster x junction x role.
gj_junc <- lfc %>%
  transmute(gene = gene_name, cluster, junction_key, dir = effect_direction) %>%
  mutate(role = case_when(
    str_detect(dir, regex("increas", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "risk",
    str_detect(dir, regex("decreas", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "nonrisk",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(role), !is.na(junction_key), !is.na(cluster)) %>%
  distinct(gene, cluster, junction_key, role)
stopifnot("a junction carries both roles" =
  nrow(gj_junc %>% count(gene, cluster, junction_key) %>% filter(n > 1)) == 0)

# Risk / nonrisk isoform sets per junction.
gs3_junc <- gj_junc %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    own        = list(isoforms_with(junction_key)),
    comp_juncs = list(gj_junc$junction_key[gj_junc$gene == gene &
                                           gj_junc$cluster == cluster &
                                           gj_junc$role != role]),
    comp       = list(if (length(unlist(comp_juncs)))
                        isoforms_with(unlist(comp_juncs)) else character(0)),
    used_complement = length(unlist(comp)) == 0,
    all_iso    = list(all_iso_of(gene)),
    other      = list(if (used_complement) setdiff(all_iso, own) else comp),
    R          = list(if (role == "risk")    own else other),
    N          = list(if (role == "nonrisk") own else other),
    amb        = list(intersect(R, N)),
    R = list(setdiff(R, amb)), N = list(setdiff(N, amb))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(nR = lengths(R), nN = lengths(N), usable = nR > 0 & nN > 0)

# Classify every detected peptide against each usable junction's sets.
pc_j <- cov %>%
  filter(!is.na(seq_pbs)) %>%
  inner_join(gs3_junc %>% filter(usable) %>%
               select(gene, cluster, junction_key, R, N),
             by = c("gene_symbol" = "gene"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(hR = map2_lgl(seq_pbs, R, ~ any(.x %in% .y)),
         hN = map2_lgl(seq_pbs, N, ~ any(.x %in% .y)),
         cls = case_when(hR & !hN ~ "Risk", !hR & hN ~ "Nonrisk",
                         hR &  hN ~ "Both (shared)", TRUE ~ "Neither"))

# Per-junction summary over ALL usable junctions.
junction_summary <- pc_j %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol, junction_key) %>%
  summarise(n_risk    = sum(cls == "Risk"),
            n_nonrisk = sum(cls == "Nonrisk"),
            n_shared  = sum(cls == "Both (shared)"),
            .groups = "drop")

all_usable <- gs3_junc %>% filter(usable) %>%
  group_by(gene, junction_key) %>%
  summarise(used_complement = any(used_complement), .groups = "drop")

junction_validation <- all_usable %>%
  left_join(junction_summary, by = c("gene" = "gene_symbol", "junction_key")) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("n_"), ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)),
         validated = (n_risk + n_nonrisk) > 0,
         side = case_when(n_risk > 0 & n_nonrisk > 0 ~ "Both sides",
                          n_risk > 0                 ~ "Risk only",
                          n_nonrisk > 0              ~ "Nonrisk only",
                          TRUE                       ~ "None"))

cat(sprintf("usable junctions %d | validated %d (%.0f%%)\n",
            nrow(junction_validation), sum(junction_validation$validated),
            100 * mean(junction_validation$validated)))
cat("probeable subset:\n")
print(junction_validation %>% filter(junction_key %in% probeable_keys) %>% count(side))

# Exclusivity ceiling: for each junction, whether a risk- or nonrisk-exclusive tryptic
# peptide exists in the digest at all, and whether one was detected. Separates
# "impossible to distinguish" from "possible but not detected".
cl_by_gene  <- cleaver_lookup %>%
  select(gene_symbol, peptide_seq_aa, pb_ids_list) %>% split(.$gene_symbol)
det_by_gene <- detected_pep %>% split(.$gene_symbol)

excl_junc <- gs3_junc %>%
  filter(usable) %>%
  select(gene, cluster, junction_key, role, R, N) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(.res = list({
    cl <- cl_by_gene[[gene]]
    if (is.null(cl)) {
      tibble(n_R_possible = 0L, n_N_possible = 0L,
             n_R_detected = 0L, n_N_detected = 0L)
    } else {
      pbs  <- lapply(cl$pb_ids_list, function(x) intersect(x, c(R, N)))
      keep <- lengths(pbs) > 0
      cl   <- cl[keep, ]; pbs <- pbs[keep]
      hR   <- vapply(pbs, function(x) any(x %in% R), logical(1))
      hN   <- vapply(pbs, function(x) any(x %in% N), logical(1))
      cls  <- ifelse(hR & !hN, "R-exclusive",
              ifelse(!hR & hN, "N-exclusive", "shared"))
      det  <- det_by_gene[[gene]]$pep
      tibble(n_R_possible = sum(cls == "R-exclusive"),
             n_N_possible = sum(cls == "N-exclusive"),
             n_R_detected = sum(cls == "R-exclusive" & cl$peptide_seq_aa %in% det),
             n_N_detected = sum(cls == "N-exclusive" & cl$peptide_seq_aa %in% det))
    }
  })) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  tidyr::unnest(.res) %>%
  select(-R, -N) %>%
  # A junction evaluated in two clusters keeps the maximum, as junction_validation does.
  group_by(gene, junction_key) %>%
  summarise(across(c(n_R_possible, n_N_possible, n_R_detected, n_N_detected), max),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(is_probeable = junction_key %in% probeable_keys,
         risk_status = case_when(n_R_possible == 0 ~ "impossible (no unique peptide)",
                                 n_R_detected  > 0 ~ "detected",
                                 TRUE              ~ "possible, not detected"),
         nonrisk_status = case_when(n_N_possible == 0 ~ "impossible (no unique peptide)",
                                    n_N_detected  > 0 ~ "detected",
                                    TRUE              ~ "possible, not detected"))

# Consistency: the two junction-level tables describe the same junctions and agree on
# which sides were detected.
stopifnot("excl_junc and junction_validation differ in size" =
            nrow(excl_junc) == nrow(junction_validation))
disagree <- excl_junc %>%
  select(gene, junction_key, risk_status, nonrisk_status) %>%
  inner_join(junction_validation %>% select(junction_key, side), by = "junction_key") %>%
  filter((risk_status == "detected") != (side %in% c("Risk only", "Both sides")) |
         (nonrisk_status == "detected") != (side %in% c("Nonrisk only", "Both sides")))
cat(sprintf("side-level disagreements between the two tables: %d\n", nrow(disagree)))

write_excel_csv(junction_validation, OUT_JUNCTION_VALIDATION)
write_excel_csv(excl_junc, OUT_JUNCTION_EXCLUSIVE_PEPS)

# Reason a junction could not be classified, for the junction master table (script 10).
gs3_junc <- gs3_junc %>%
  mutate(not_usable_reason = case_when(
    usable                ~ NA_character_,
    lengths(own)   == 0   ~ "junction in no long-read isoform",
    lengths(other) == 0   ~ "no complementary isoforms",
    nR == 0 & nN == 0     ~ "both sides emptied by ambiguity",
    nR == 0               ~ "risk side emptied by ambiguity",
    nN == 0               ~ "nonrisk side emptied by ambiguity"))
write_excel_csv(
  gs3_junc %>% filter(!usable) %>%
    distinct(junction_key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(gene, junction_key, not_usable_reason),
  OUT_JUNCTION_NOT_USABLE)
```

## 18. Evidence chain

One table with every junction count quoted in the text, each with its source object, and the
arithmetic that must hold between them.

```{r evidence_chain}
chain <- function(step, n, source) tibble::tibble(step, n, source)

ec <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  chain("sGenes",                     dplyr::n_distinct(lfc$gene_name),   "lfc"),
  chain("junction x condition rows",  nrow(lfc),                          "lfc"),
  chain("distinct CAD junctions",     dplyr::n_distinct(lfc$junction_key), "lfc"),
  chain("probeable (CDS)",            sum(funnel$probeable),              "funnel"),
  chain("LR-captured",                sum(funnel$lr_captured),            "funnel"),
  chain("usable junctions",           nrow(junction_validation),          "gs3_junc"),
  chain("  probeable & usable",
        sum(junction_validation$junction_key %in% probeable_keys),        "join"),
  chain("  UTR & usable",
        sum(!junction_validation$junction_key %in% probeable_keys),       "join"),
  chain("validated (probeable)",
        sum(junction_validation$validated &
            junction_validation$junction_key %in% probeable_keys),        "join"),
  chain("  risk only",
        sum(junction_validation$side == "Risk only" &
            junction_validation$junction_key %in% probeable_keys),        "join"),
  chain("  nonrisk only",
        sum(junction_validation$side == "Nonrisk only" &
            junction_validation$junction_key %in% probeable_keys),        "join"),
  chain("  both sides",
        sum(junction_validation$side == "Both sides" &
            junction_validation$junction_key %in% probeable_keys),        "join"),
  chain("validated (UTR)",
        sum(junction_validation$validated &
            !junction_validation$junction_key %in% probeable_keys),       "join")
)

stopifnot(
  "probeable & usable + probeable & not usable != probeable" =
    sum(junction_validation$junction_key %in% probeable_keys) +
    length(setdiff(probeable_keys, junction_validation$junction_key)) ==
    sum(funnel$probeable),
  "sides do not sum to validated" =
    sum(junction_validation$side %in% c("Risk only", "Nonrisk only", "Both sides")) ==
    sum(junction_validation$validated)
)

print(as.data.frame(ec), row.names = FALSE, right = FALSE)
write_excel_csv(ec, OUT_EVIDENCE_CHAIN)
```

## 19. Supplementary Table 12 — peptide evidence in CAD sGenes

One row per evaluable peptide with its isoform mapping, risk/nonrisk class and detection
method. Column dictionary: `sqtl_isoform_class` — Risk / Nonrisk / Both (shared) / Neither
against the risk and nonrisk isoform sets of that cluster; `peptide_specificity` —
isoform-specific / informative / constitutive, from the Cleaver digest; `isoforms_evidenced` —
the isoforms the classification rests on; `all_isoforms_with_peptide` — every isoform whose
digest contains the peptide, including ones outside the cluster's sets; `detection_method` —
Discovery, IS-PRM or both.

```{r supp_table_peptides}
# PB -> ENST / category / CPM lookup. tx_transcripts holds the matched reference transcript
# ("novel" where there is none).
pb_annot <- read_tsv(F_SQANTI_PROTEIN_TSV, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(pb_acc     = pb,
            enst       = na_if(as.character(tx_transcripts), "novel"),
            tx_cat, pr_splice_cat, is_nmd,
            gene_id    = as.character(tx_gene)) %>%
  distinct(pb_acc, .keep_all = TRUE)

cpm_lookup <- sqp %>%
  transmute(pb_acc = str_extract(as.character(.data[[pbc]]), "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"),
            CPM = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(CPM))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pb_acc)) %>% distinct(pb_acc, .keep_all = TRUE)

annot_str <- function(pbs, col) {
  if (!length(pbs)) return(NA_character_)
  v <- pb_annot[[col]][match(pbs, pb_annot$pb_acc)]
  v <- v[!is.na(v)]
  if (!length(v)) NA_character_ else paste(sort(unique(v)), collapse = "; ")
}

supp_peptides <- detail %>%
  left_join(cleaver_lookup %>%
              transmute(gene_symbol, peptide = peptide_seq_aa,
                        peptide_specificity = cleaver_category,
                        gene_specificity,
                        n_isoforms_with_seq, n_isoforms_total) %>%
              distinct(gene_symbol, peptide, .keep_all = TRUE),
            by = c("gene_symbol", "peptide")) %>%
  left_join(peptides %>% transmute(peptide = pep, via_isprm, via_discovery),
            by = "peptide") %>%
  mutate(detection_method = case_when(
           via_isprm & via_discovery ~ "Discovery + IS-PRM",
           via_isprm                 ~ "IS-PRM",
           via_discovery             ~ "Discovery",
           TRUE                      ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    .ev  = list(str_extract_all(isoforms_evidenced,        "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")[[1]]),
    .all = list(str_extract_all(all_isoforms_with_peptide, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")[[1]]),
    ensts_evidenced    = annot_str(.ev,  "enst"),
    gene_id            = annot_str(.all, "gene_id"),
    tx_categories      = annot_str(.ev,  "tx_cat"),
    protein_categories = annot_str(.ev,  "pr_splice_cat"),
    total_CPM_evidenced = {
      v <- cpm_lookup$CPM[match(.ev, cpm_lookup$pb_acc)]
      if (all(is.na(v))) NA_real_ else round(sum(v, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
    }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    gene_symbol,
    gene_id,
    leafcutter_cluster        = cluster,
    peptide,
    peptide_length            = nchar(peptide),
    sqtl_isoform_class        = as.character(peptide_class),
    peptide_specificity,
    gene_specificity,
    n_isoforms_with_peptide   = n_isoforms_with_seq,
    n_isoforms_in_gene        = n_isoforms_total,
    isoforms_evidenced        = isoforms_evidenced,
    n_isoforms_evidenced,
    ensts_evidenced,
    tx_categories,
    protein_categories,
    total_CPM_evidenced,
    all_isoforms_with_peptide,
    detection_method) %>%
  arrange(gene_symbol, leafcutter_cluster,
          factor(sqtl_isoform_class, levels = c("Risk", "Nonrisk", "Both (shared)", "Neither")),
          desc(n_isoforms_evidenced))

stopifnot("row count changed against `detail`" = nrow(supp_peptides) == nrow(detail))
cat(sprintf("Supplementary Table 12: %d peptides | %d genes | %d clusters\n",
            nrow(supp_peptides), n_distinct(supp_peptides$gene_symbol),
            n_distinct(supp_peptides$leafcutter_cluster)))
write_excel_csv(supp_peptides, OUT_PEPTIDE_SUPP_TABLE)
```

## 20. Peptide-supported isoforms with notable features (Extended Data Fig. 5c)

An isoform is listed when a CAD-validating peptide is exclusive to isoforms sharing a
feature of interest: novel protein (pNIC/pNNC), novel transcript (NIC/NNC), predicted NMD, or
retained intron. Exclusivity is assessed over the complete membership set from the digest, so a
peptide shared with any annotated, non-NMD isoform does not count as evidence for the feature.

```{r interesting_isoforms}
NOVEL_CATS <- c("novel_in_catalog", "novel_not_in_catalog")
RI_SUBCATS <- c("intron_retention", "mono-exon_by_intron_retention")

iso_flags <- sqanti_protein_cpm %>%
  transmute(
    pb_id = pb, tx_cat, pr_splice_cat, tx_subcat, is_nmd,
    novel_by_tx     = tx_cat        %in% NOVEL_CATS,
    novel_by_pr     = pr_splice_cat %in% NOVEL_CATS,
    nmd_candidate   = is_nmd %in% TRUE,
    retained_intron = tx_subcat %in% RI_SUBCATS,
    # Annotated transcript structure with a predicted ORF that differs from the annotated one.
    alt_orf_on_known_tx = !novel_by_tx & novel_by_pr) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pb_id))

# One row per (peptide, isoform).
cleaver_long <- cleaver_lookup %>%
  transmute(pep = toupper(peptide_seq_aa), gene = gene_symbol, pb_ids_list) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(pb_ids_list) %>%
  rename(pb_id = pb_ids_list) %>%
  filter(str_detect(pb_id, "^PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")) %>%
  left_join(iso_flags, by = "pb_id")

# Per-peptide exclusivity over the full membership set.
pep_excl <- cleaver_long %>%
  group_by(pep) %>%
  summarise(
    any_novel_pr = any(novel_by_pr,         na.rm = TRUE),
    any_novel_tx = any(novel_by_tx,         na.rm = TRUE),
    any_nmd      = any(nmd_candidate,       na.rm = TRUE),
    any_ir       = any(retained_intron,     na.rm = TRUE),
    any_altorf   = any(alt_orf_on_known_tx, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_known_pr   = sum(novel_by_pr         == FALSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_known_tx   = sum(novel_by_tx         == FALSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nonnmd     = sum(nmd_candidate       == FALSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nonir      = sum(retained_intron     == FALSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nonaltorf  = sum(alt_orf_on_known_tx == FALSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(only_novel_pr = any_novel_pr & n_known_pr  == 0,
         only_novel_tx = any_novel_tx & n_known_tx  == 0,
         only_nmd      = any_nmd      & n_nonnmd    == 0,
         only_ir       = any_ir       & n_nonir     == 0,
         only_altorf   = any_altorf   & n_nonaltorf == 0)

# CAD-validating peptides: Risk or Nonrisk in the junction-membership classification.
pep_source_cad <- pep_class %>%
  filter(junction_validating) %>%
  transmute(pep) %>% distinct() %>%
  left_join(peptides %>% transmute(pep, via_isprm, via_dda = via_discovery), by = "pep")

# Roll up to isoforms.
build_cand <- function(src) {
  cleaver_long %>%
    semi_join(src, by = "pep") %>%
    left_join(select(pep_excl, pep, only_novel_pr, only_novel_tx,
                     only_nmd, only_ir, only_altorf), by = "pep") %>%
    left_join(src, by = "pep") %>%
    group_by(pb_id) %>%
    summarise(
      gene                = dplyr::first(na.omit(gene)),
      novel_protein       = any(novel_by_pr         & only_novel_pr, na.rm = TRUE),
      novel_tx            = any(novel_by_tx         & only_novel_tx, na.rm = TRUE),
      nmd                 = any(nmd_candidate       & only_nmd,      na.rm = TRUE),
      retained_intron     = any(retained_intron     & only_ir,       na.rm = TRUE),
      alt_orf_on_known_tx = any(alt_orf_on_known_tx & only_altorf,   na.rm = TRUE),
      n_excl_pep = n_distinct(pep[only_novel_pr | only_novel_tx |
                                  only_nmd | only_ir | only_altorf]),
      via_isprm  = any(via_isprm, na.rm = TRUE),
      via_dda    = any(via_dda,   na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(novel_protein | novel_tx | nmd | retained_intron | alt_orf_on_known_tx) %>%
    arrange(desc(nmd), desc(novel_protein), desc(n_excl_pep))
}

cand <- build_cand(pep_source_cad)
cat(sprintf("CAD-validating candidate isoforms: %d (novel protein %d | novel transcript %d | NMD %d | retained intron %d)\n",
            nrow(cand), sum(cand$novel_protein), sum(cand$novel_tx),
            sum(cand$nmd), sum(cand$retained_intron)))
write_excel_csv(cand, OUT_INTERESTING_ISOFORMS)
```

## 21. IS-PRM target accounting (Methods)

The IS-PRM acquisition targeted 173 peptides selected from the digest to distinguish the risk
from the nonrisk pool of CAD sQTL isoform pairs. This section reports the targets by digest
specificity class and the number of genes covered, which are the numbers given in Methods, and
how many targets were detected.

```{r isprm_targets}
cad173 <- read_csv(F_CAD173_TARGETS, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(AAseq), AAseq != "")
cad173_peps <- unique(toupper(cad173$AAseq))

# Gene and specificity for each target, from the digest (first match per sequence).
pep_gene <- cleaver_lookup %>%
  transmute(pep = toupper(peptide_seq_aa), gene = gene_symbol,
            cleaver_category, gene_specificity) %>%
  distinct(pep, .keep_all = TRUE)

isprm_targets <- tibble(pep = cad173_peps) %>%
  left_join(pep_gene, by = "pep") %>%
  mutate(detected_isprm = pep %in% toupper(isprm_peptide_seqs)) %>%
  arrange(gene, pep)

cat(sprintf("IS-PRM targets: %d peptides from %d genes; %d detected\n",
            nrow(isprm_targets), n_distinct(na.omit(isprm_targets$gene)),
            sum(isprm_targets$detected_isprm)))
print(count(isprm_targets, cleaver_category))
write_csv(isprm_targets, file.path(RES_05, "isprm_cad173_target_summary.csv"))
```

```{r browser_panels}
stopifnot("Part B must run first (`detail` is required)" = exists("detail"))

# ---- helpers -----------------------------------------------------------------

# Versioned ENST id(s) present in gencode_exon_data for a base or versioned id.
resolve_enst <- function(x) {
  bl <- str_replace(gencode_exon_data$trans_id, "\\.[0-9]+$", "")
  q  <- str_replace(x, "\\.[0-9]+$", "")
  hit <- unique(gencode_exon_data$trans_id[bl %in% q | gencode_exon_data$trans_id %in% x])
  if (!length(hit)) warning("ENST not in gencode_exon_data: ", paste(x, collapse = ", "))
  hit
}

# ENSTs in the order requested.
resolve_enst_ordered <- function(base_ids) {
  ids <- resolve_enst(base_ids)
  ids[order(match(str_replace(ids, "\\.[0-9]+$", ""), str_replace(base_ids, "\\.[0-9]+$", "")))]
}

# GENCODE pair tibble in the shape risk_nonrisk_pairs expects.
enst_rp <- function(gene, risk = NULL, nonrisk = NULL) {
  tibble(gene_name = gene,
         risk_isoform    = if (!is.null(risk))    resolve_enst(risk)    else NA_character_,
         nonrisk_isoform = if (!is.null(nonrisk)) resolve_enst(nonrisk) else NA_character_,
         risk_pb = NA_character_, nonrisk_pb = NA_character_)
}

# Copy of snp_data with the named variant(s) flagged as lead (drawn bold).
mark_lead <- function(sdat, rsids) {
  gone <- setdiff(rsids, sdat$rsid)
  if (length(gone)) warning("not in snp_data, will not be drawn: ", paste(gone, collapse = ", "))
  sdat %>% mutate(is_lead = if_else(rsid %in% rsids, TRUE, is_lead))
}

# Arguments shared by every panel; `extra` replaces whole elements (tibbles included), which
# modifyList() would instead merge column-wise.
base_args <- function(extra) {
  args <- list(
    exon_data = exon_data, cds_data = cds_data,
    sqanti_data        = sqanti_protein_cpm,
    cluster_data       = cluster_data,
    risk_nonrisk_pairs = risk_pairs,
    pogo_data          = pogo_data,
    gencode_exon_data  = gencode_exon_data,
    gencode_cds_data   = gencode_cds_data,
    snp_data           = snp_data,
    color_by           = "risk",
    show_sqtl          = TRUE,
    show_peptides      = FALSE,
    show_snps          = TRUE,
    sqtl_cap_pt        = 1.2,
    plot_width_in      = 3.5)
  for (nm in names(extra)) args[[nm]] <- extra[[nm]]
  args
}
# Legend options shared by the long-read panels: no risk-status row, text-only row explaining
# the transcript labels.
legend_args <- function() list(show_risk_legend = FALSE, transcript_label_legend = TRUE)

# Save one panel in both views and record it in the manifest.
MANIFEST <- list()
save_panel <- function(args, stem, panel, gene, w, h, view = c("genomic", "exon"), expect = "") {
  view <- match.arg(view)
  args$plot_width_in <- w                       # keeps the sQTL cap geometry at the final width
  p_gen <- do.call(plot_transcripts_peptides_sqtl_v2, c(args, list(collapse_introns = FALSE)))
  p_ev  <- do.call(plot_transcripts_peptides_sqtl_v2, c(args, list(collapse_introns = TRUE)))
  for (ext in c("png", "svg")) {
    ggsave(file.path(BROWSER_DIR, sprintf("%s.%s", stem, ext)), p_gen,
           width = w, height = h, units = "in", dpi = 300)
    ggsave(file.path(BROWSER_DIR, sprintf("%s_exonview.%s", stem, ext)), p_ev,
           width = w, height = h, units = "in", dpi = 300)
  }
  MANIFEST[[length(MANIFEST) + 1]] <<- tibble(
    panel = panel, gene = gene, stem = stem, view = view, width_in = w, height_in = h,
    transcripts = paste(args$transcript_ids, collapse = "; "),
    risk    = paste(c(args$manual_risk_pbs,
                      args$risk_nonrisk_pairs$risk_isoform[args$risk_nonrisk_pairs$gene_name == gene]),
                    collapse = "; "),
    nonrisk = paste(c(args$manual_nonrisk_pbs,
                      args$risk_nonrisk_pairs$nonrisk_isoform[args$risk_nonrisk_pairs$gene_name == gene]),
                    collapse = "; "),
    peptides = if (is.null(args$selected_peptides)) "" else
      paste(sprintf("%s=%s", args$selected_peptides,
                    args$peptide_status_map[args$selected_peptides]), collapse = "; "),
    expected_content = expect)
  cat(sprintf("  %-10s %-9s %s  (%.1f x %.1f in, %s view)\n", panel, gene, stem, w, h, view))
  invisible(list(genomic = p_gen, exonview = p_ev))
}

# ---- peptide panels ------------------------------------------------------------
# Risk isoform = the risk-junction isoform with the most distinguishing-peptide evidence;
# nonrisk likewise. Peptide colour = its class (Risk / Nonrisk / Both).
best_isoform <- function(g, side) {
  d <- detail %>% filter(gene_symbol == g, peptide_class == side,
                         !is.na(isoforms_evidenced), isoforms_evidenced != "")
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NA_character_)
  d %>% separate_rows(isoforms_evidenced, sep = ";\\s*") %>%
    filter(isoforms_evidenced != "") %>%
    count(pb = isoforms_evidenced, sort = TRUE) %>% slice(1) %>% pull(pb)
}

# Peptides to draw for one gene.
#   include_shared : keep "Both (shared)" peptides
#   prefer_specific: when a Risk or Nonrisk peptide exists, drop the shared ones
#   isprm_only / isprm_classes : restrict (all classes / named classes) to IS-PRM detections
#   max_per_class  : best N per class (IS-PRM first, then most isoforms, then longest)
peptides_jm <- function(g, include_shared = FALSE, prefer_specific = TRUE,
                        isprm_only = FALSE, isprm_classes = NULL, max_per_class = 1) {
  d <- detail %>% filter(gene_symbol == g, peptide_class != "Neither")
  if (isprm_only) d <- d %>% filter(detected_by == "IS-PRM")
  if (!is.null(isprm_classes))
    d <- d %>% filter(!(peptide_class %in% isprm_classes) | detected_by == "IS-PRM")
  if (!include_shared) d <- d %>% filter(peptide_class != "Both (shared)")
  if (prefer_specific && any(d$peptide_class %in% c("Risk", "Nonrisk")))
    d <- d %>% filter(peptide_class %in% c("Risk", "Nonrisk"))
  if (!is.null(max_per_class))
    d <- d %>%
      mutate(.isprm = as.integer(detected_by == "IS-PRM"), .nlen = nchar(peptide)) %>%
      arrange(peptide_class, desc(.isprm), desc(n_isoforms_evidenced), desc(.nlen), peptide) %>%
      group_by(peptide_class) %>% slice_head(n = max_per_class) %>% ungroup()
  d <- d %>% mutate(status = recode(as.character(peptide_class), "Both (shared)" = "Both")) %>%
    distinct(peptide, status)
  list(seqs = d$peptide, status_map = setNames(d$status, d$peptide))
}

# One peptide panel.
#   risk_pb / nonrisk_pb : NULL = pick by evidence (best_isoform)
#   pf_override          : named vector c(PEPTIDE = "Risk", ...) to draw exactly these peptides
#   drop_direction       : hide sQTL junctions with this effect_direction (e.g. "Increased")
#   keep_features        : regex on unip_interest$name to keep only some regions of interest
peptide_panel <- function(g, panel, stem, w = 4.5, h = 2,
                          risk_pb = NULL, nonrisk_pb = NULL, pf_override = NULL,
                          show_tracks = c("domains"), show_features = c("domain"),
                          keep_features = NULL, drop_direction = NULL,
                          include_shared = FALSE, max_per_class = 1, isprm_only = FALSE,
                          isprm_classes = NULL, exact_peptides = TRUE,
                          collapse_rpt = g %in% c("LDLR"), expect = "") {
  if (is.null(risk_pb))    risk_pb    <- best_isoform(g, "Risk")
  if (is.null(nonrisk_pb)) nonrisk_pb <- best_isoform(g, "Nonrisk")
  if (is.na(risk_pb) || is.na(nonrisk_pb)) {
    warning(g, ": no evidenced isoform on one side; skipped"); return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  tx_ids <- get_transcript_ids_for_gene(exon_data, g, c(risk_pb, nonrisk_pb))
  if (length(tx_ids) < 2) {
    warning(g, ": ", length(tx_ids), "/2 transcripts in exon_data; skipped"); return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  pf <- if (!is.null(pf_override))
          list(seqs = names(pf_override), status_map = pf_override)
        else peptides_jm(g, include_shared = include_shared, max_per_class = max_per_class,
                         isprm_only = isprm_only, isprm_classes = isprm_classes)
  if (!length(pf$seqs)) { warning(g, ": no peptides; skipped"); return(invisible(NULL)) }

  ui <- if (is.null(keep_features)) unip_interest else
          unip_interest %>% filter(str_detect(name, keep_features))
  args <- base_args(c(list(
    unip_domain = unip_domain, unip_interest = ui, unip_transmembrane = unip_transmembrane,
    transcript_ids = tx_ids, gene_name_for_cluster = g,
    manual_risk_pbs = risk_pb, manual_nonrisk_pbs = nonrisk_pb,
    show_snps = FALSE, show_peptides = TRUE, peptides_overlap_sqtl = FALSE,
    show_tracks = show_tracks, show_features = show_features,
    transcript_label_wrap = FALSE, collapse_repeat_numbers = collapse_rpt,
    selected_peptides = pf$seqs, peptide_status_map = pf$status_map,
    exact_peptides = exact_peptides, title = g), legend_args()))
  if (!is.null(drop_direction))
    args$cluster_data <- args$cluster_data %>%
      filter(!(gene_name == g & effect_direction %in% drop_direction))
  save_panel(args, stem, panel, g, w, h, view = "exon", expect = expect)
}

# 1. Fig. 3e CABIN1, 3f CNN1; ED Fig. 3g RNF5, 3h HEPH — transcript models coloured by novelty
#    (the right-hand half of each donut panel; no sQTL tracks)
# ==============================================================================
novelty <- tribble(
  ~panel,        ~gene,    ~stem,          ~ids,                                   ~expect,
  "Fig. 3e",     "CABIN1", "Fig3e_CABIN1", list(c("PB.18162.3", "PB.18162.29")),   "novel PB.18162.29 vs annotated ENST00000263119.10",
  "Fig. 3f",     "CNN1",   "Fig3f_CNN1",   list(c("PB.16522.1", "PB.16522.2")),    "novel PB.16522.2 vs annotated ENST00000252456.7",
  "ED Fig. 3g",  "RNF5",   "ED3g_RNF5",    list(c("ENST00000375094", "PB.6529.2")), "novel PB.6529.2 vs GENCODE ENST00000375094.4 (no VSMC FSM)",
  "ED Fig. 3h",  "HEPH",   "ED3h_HEPH",    list(c("PB.18756.1", "PB.18756.6")),    "novel PB.18756.6 vs annotated ENST00000343002.7")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(novelty))) {
  r   <- novelty[i, ]
  ids <- unlist(r$ids)
  tx_ids <- unlist(lapply(ids, function(x) if (grepl("^ENST", x)) resolve_enst(x)
                                          else get_transcript_ids_for_gene(exon_data, r$gene, x)))
  if (length(tx_ids) < 2) { warning(r$gene, ": ", length(tx_ids), "/2 transcripts found; skipped"); next }
  save_panel(base_args(list(
    transcript_ids = tx_ids, gene_name_for_cluster = r$gene,
    color_by = "novelty", show_tracks = character(0),
    show_snps = FALSE, show_sqtl = FALSE, show_peptides = FALSE, shadow_gencode = FALSE,
    transcript_label_wrap = FALSE, title = r$gene, transcript_label_legend = TRUE)),
    r$stem, r$panel, r$gene, w = 5.1, h = 2.0, view = "genomic", expect = r$expect)
}

ed6 <- tribble(
  ~panel,        ~gene,      ~stem,           ~tracks,                        ~features,                          ~expect,
  "ED Fig. 6a",  "HSD17B12", "ED6a_HSD17B12", list(c("domains", "topology")), list(c("domain", "transmembrane")), "nonrisk ENST00000278353.10; risk ENST00000395700.4; transmembrane regions",
  "ED Fig. 6c",  "ITGA2",    "ED6c_ITGA2",    list("domains"),                list("domain"),                     "nonrisk ENST00000296585.10; risk PB.5451.14; VWFA domain",
  "ED Fig. 6e",  "DAGLB",    "ED6e_DAGLB",    list("domains"),                list("domain"),                     "nonrisk PB.7302.14; risk PB.7302.1; fungal lipase-type domain",
  "ED Fig. 6g",  "DSTN",     "ED6g_DSTN",     list("domains"),                list("domain"),                     "nonrisk ENST00000474024.5; risk PB.17466.1; ADF-H domain")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(ed6))) {
  r <- ed6[i, ]
  peptide_panel(r$gene, r$panel, r$stem, w = 4.5, h = 2,
                show_tracks = unlist(r$tracks), show_features = unlist(r$features), expect = r$expect)
}

# ==============================================================================
# 9. Fig. 6a SRP54, 6f MLX, 6k ITGA1 — AP-MS bait pairs (isoforms fixed to the baits)
# ==============================================================================
peptide_panel("SRP54", "Fig. 6a", "Fig6a_SRP54", w = 4.2, h = 2,
              risk_pb = "PB.13005.14", nonrisk_pb = "PB.13005.1",
              pf_override = c(LMTIMDSMNDQGGDMSK = "Risk", DVQELLTQYTK = "Nonrisk"),
              show_tracks = c("domains"), show_features = c("interest"), keep_features = "M-domain",
              expect = "nonrisk ENST00000216774.11; risk ENST00000555746.6; M-domain")
peptide_panel("MLX", "Fig. 6f", "Fig6f_MLX", w = 4.2, h = 2,
              risk_pb = "PB.15434.2", nonrisk_pb = "PB.15434.10", include_shared = TRUE,
              show_tracks = c("domains"), show_features = c("interest"),
              expect = "nonrisk PB.15434.10; risk ENST00000435881.7; disordered regions; leucine zipper")
peptide_panel("ITGA1", "Fig. 6k", "Fig6k_ITGA1", w = 4.2, h = 2,
              risk_pb = "PB.5448.10", nonrisk_pb = "PB.5448.2", include_shared = TRUE,
              pf_override = c(VTLDSLR = "Nonrisk", GESLPCVK = "Both"),
              show_tracks = c("domains", "topology"), show_features = c("domain", "transmembrane"),
              drop_direction = "Increased",
              expect = "nonrisk ENST00000282588.7; risk PB.5448.10; decreased junction only; VWFA; transmembrane")

# ==============================================================================
# 10. Manifest
# ==============================================================================
manifest <- bind_rows(MANIFEST)
write_csv(manifest, file.path(BROWSER_DIR, "BROWSER_MANIFEST.csv"))
cat(sprintf("\n%d panels written to %s\n", nrow(manifest), BROWSER_DIR))
```
